quote: However, many factors affect how well GABA works, which include heavy metal (Struzyńska and Sulkowski 2004), antibiotics (Matsuo et al. 1998), insecticide (Sánchez-Borzone et al. 2017), and other biological toxins (Kudryavtsev et al. 2015).
statement: 重金属、抗生素、杀虫剂和其他生物毒素等多种因素会影响GABA的功能。
text_zh: 重金属、抗生素、杀虫剂和其他生物毒素等多种因素会影响GABA的功能。
text_en: Various factors such as heavy metals, antibiotics, pesticides and other biotoxins affect GABA function.
intervention_record: 环境污染物及药物暴露

quote: The imbalances of excitatory or inhibitory neurotransmitters caused by drugs can lead to nerve abnormalities, causing organisms to exhibit symptoms of nerve poisoning.
statement: 药物引起的兴奋性或抑制性神经递质失衡可导致神经异常，使生物体表现出神经中毒症状。
text_zh: 药物引起的兴奋性或抑制性神经递质失衡可导致神经异常，使生物体表现出神经中毒症状。
text_en: Drug-induced excitatory or inhibitory neurotransmitter imbalance can lead to neurological abnormalities, causing organisms to exhibit symptoms of neurotoxicity.

quote: However, the side effects of FQs have been widely reported in recent years, such as its muscular toxicity (Demetrious 2018), renal toxicity (Owens and Ambrose 2005), and neurotoxicity (Xiao et al. 2018).
statement: 近年来，氟喹诺酮类药物的副作用被广泛报道，包括肌肉毒性、肾毒性和神经毒性。
text_zh: 近年来，氟喹诺酮类药物的副作用被广泛报道，包括肌肉毒性、肾毒性和神经毒性。
text_en: In recent years, the side effects of fluoroquinolones have been widely reported, including muscle toxicity, kidney toxicity, and neurotoxicity.

quote: Many reports suggested FQs could have caused severe neurotoxic reactions, which lead to hallucinations, depression, and other neurological diseases (Barrett and Login 2009 ; Grill and Maganti 2011 ; Guiol et al. 1993).
statement: 许多报告表明，氟喹诺酮类药物可能引起严重的神经毒性反应，导致幻觉、抑郁和其他神经系统疾病。
text_zh: 许多报告表明，氟喹诺酮类药物可能引起严重的神经毒性反应，导致幻觉、抑郁和其他神经系统疾病。
text_en: Many reports indicate that fluoroquinolones may cause severe neurotoxic reactions, leading to hallucinations, depression, and other neurological disorders.

quote: The fishes were placed in a cool box with the local lake water, and transferred immediately to the laboratory as soon as possible and were examined within 24 hours after their capture.
statement: 鱼被放入装有当地湖水的冷藏箱中，并尽快转移到实验室，在捕获后24小时内进行检查。
text_zh: 鱼被放入装有当地湖水的冷藏箱中，并尽快转移到实验室，在捕获后24小时内进行检查。
text_en: Fish were placed in coolers containing local lake water and transferred to the laboratory as soon as possible, for examination within 24 hours of capture.

quote: Percentage incidence of infection: 7.69%
statement: 感染率为7.69%。
text_zh: 感染率为7.69%。
text_en: The infection rate was 7.69%.

quote: Mean of intensity: 8.5
statement: 平均感染强度为8.5。
text_zh: 平均感染强度为8.5。
text_en: The average infection intensity was 8.5.

quote: After been exposed to AVM at the SC (0.0039 mg/L) and LC 50 (0.039 mg/L), the mRNA expressions of GAD and GABA-T both in the brain and peripheral tissues of crucian carp were inhibited significantly in this paper
statement: 在亚致死浓度和半数致死浓度暴露于阿维菌素后，鲫鱼脑部和外周组织中GAD和GABA-T的mRNA表达均受到显著抑制。
text_zh: 在亚致死浓度和半数致死浓度暴露于阿维菌素后，鲫鱼脑部和外周组织中GAD和GABA-T的mRNA表达均受到显著抑制。
text_en: After exposure to abamectin at sublethal and median lethal concentrations, mRNA expression of GAD and GABA-T in the brain and peripheral tissues of crucian carp was significantly inhibited.
outcome: 神经系统功能与基因表达

quote: This result indicated that the central nervous system was influenced by AVM in crucian carp.
statement: 该结果表明阿维菌素影响了鲫鱼的神经系统。
text_zh: 该结果表明阿维菌素影响了鲫鱼的神经系统。
text_en: This result indicates that abamectin affected the nervous system of crucian carp.

quote: But on the contrary, GAD and GABA-T levels were extremely inhibited in the muscle after treated with AVM at the SC or at the LC 50 (Fig. 8 and Table 3), which suggested that neuromuscular synthesis and metabolic rate of GABA were stagnant.
statement: 在SC或LC50浓度下用AVM处理导致肌肉中GAD和GABA-T水平受到极大抑制，表明GABA的神经肌肉合成和代谢率停滞。
text_zh: 在SC或LC50浓度下用AVM处理导致肌肉中GAD和GABA-T水平受到极大抑制，表明GABA的神经肌肉合成和代谢率停滞。
text_en: Treatment with AVM at SC or LC50 concentrations resulted in extreme inhibition of GAD and GABA-T levels in muscle, indicating a stagnation of the neuromuscular synthesis and metabolic rate of GABA.
outcome: 神经递质代谢与肌肉功能

quote: which suggested that neuromuscular synthesis and metabolic rate of GABA were stagnant.
statement: 这表明神经肌肉中GABA的合成和代谢速率停滞。
text_zh: 这表明神经肌肉中GABA的合成和代谢速率停滞。
text_en: This indicates that the synthesis and metabolic rates of GABA in neuromuscular tissue are stagnant.

quote: Previous study found that crucian carp suffered from impatience and restlessness, body type tremors when treated with DIF (Ruan et al. 2014a).
statement: 先前的研究发现，当用双氟沙星（DIF）处理时，鲫鱼表现出急躁不安和身体震颤。
text_zh: 先前的研究发现，当用双氟沙星（DIF）处理时，鲫鱼表现出急躁不安和身体震颤。
text_en: Previous studies have found that when treated with difloxacin (DIF), crucian carp exhibited restlessness and body tremors.

quote: However, GABA-T levels were significantly upregulated at 120 h in Tel and Cer after treated with DIF at its SD, which seemed to suggest that DIF could stimulate the overexpression of GABA-T to consume the GABA flux in the nerve center as an antagonistic inhibitor of GABA and enhance the convulsion effect of crucian carp.
statement: 在亚致死剂量（SD）的DIF处理下，鲫鱼端脑和小脑中的GABA-T水平在120小时显著上调，这似乎表明DIF可能刺激GABA-T过表达以消耗神经中枢中的GABA通量，作为GABA的拮抗抑制剂并增强鲫鱼的惊厥效应。
text_zh: 在亚致死剂量（SD）的DIF处理下，鲫鱼端脑和小脑中的GABA-T水平在120小时显著上调，这似乎表明DIF可能刺激GABA-T过表达以消耗神经中枢中的GABA通量，作为GABA的拮抗抑制剂并增强鲫鱼的惊厥效应。
text_en: Under sublethal dose (SD) DIF treatment, GABA-T levels in the telencephalon and cerebellum of crucian carp were significantly upregulated at 120 hours, which seems to indicate that DIF may stimulate GABA-T overexpression to consume GABA flux in the central nervous system, acting as an antagonistic inhibitor of GABA and enhancing convulsive effects in crucian carp.
outcome: 神经系统毒性/惊厥反应

quote: This may lead to an imbalance in muscular nerve regulation, such as pathological convulsion of muscle.
statement: 这种代谢停滞可能导致肌肉神经调节失衡，例如病理性肌肉抽搐。
text_zh: 这种代谢停滞可能导致肌肉神经调节失衡，例如病理性肌肉抽搐。
text_en: This metabolic stagnation may lead to neuromuscular dysregulation, such as pathological muscle twitching.
outcome: 肌肉神经调节与病理抽搐

quote: Similar findings were also found that the status of crucian carp was in physical imbalance and has a slower respiration rate after AVM treatments (Wang and Lu 2010).
statement: 类似的研究发现，经AVM处理后，鲫鱼处于身体失衡状态且呼吸频率减慢。
text_zh: 类似的研究发现，经AVM处理后，鲫鱼处于身体失衡状态且呼吸频率减慢。
text_en: Similar studies found that after AVM treatment, crucian carp were in a state of body imbalance and had a slowed respiratory rate.

quote: These results indicate that Ca HV infection results in the activation of circulatory or immune system in the survivors of all three gibel carp clones.
statement: Ca HV感染导致所有三个银鲫克隆存活个体的循环或免疫系统激活。
text_zh: Ca HV感染导致所有三个银鲫克隆存活个体的循环或免疫系统激活。
text_en: Ca HV infection led to the activation of the circulatory or immune system in all three surviving cloned Carassius auratus gibelio individuals.

quote: In addition, the results also imply the obvious pathological changes in circulatory system occurred in susceptible clone A + , consistent with the main symptom of breeding in gibel carp after Ca HV challenge.
statement: 此外，结果还暗示易感克隆A+发生了明显的循环系统病理变化，这与鲤鲫在Ca HV攻击后的主要养殖症状一致。
text_zh: 此外，结果还暗示易感克隆A+发生了明显的循环系统病理变化，这与鲤鲫在Ca HV攻击后的主要养殖症状一致。
text_en: In addition, the results also suggest that susceptible clone A+ underwent significant circulatory system pathological changes, which are consistent with the main farming symptoms of carp and crucian carp after Ca HV attack.
outcome: 循环系统健康/病理状态

quote: A few of Ca HV particles were detected with loads of 10 1.27 ± 0.31 , 10 0.73 ± 0.07 , and 10 0.70 ± 0.16 particles/ng DNA in survivors from clone A + , F and H respectively, implying that survivors had conquered the herpesvirus and eventually survived with Ca HV carrier state.
statement: 在克隆A+、F和H的存活个体中检测到少量Ca HV颗粒，表明这些存活者已战胜疱疹病毒并以Ca HV携带状态生存。
text_zh: 在克隆A+、F和H的存活个体中检测到少量Ca HV颗粒，表明这些存活者已战胜疱疹病毒并以Ca HV携带状态生存。
text_en: A small number of Ca HV particles were detected in the surviving individuals of clones A+, F, and H, indicating that these survivors had overcome herpesvirus infection and survived as Ca HV carriers.

quote: Different from lower viral loads in resistant clone H than that in susceptible clone A + during the early infected stage (1–5 dpi) [ 29 , 40 ], higher viral loads were detected in the diseased individuals of clone H (10 6.29 ± 0.14) than that in the diseased individuals of clone A + (10 5.61 ± 0.02) (Fig. 1b).
statement: 与早期感染阶段（1-5 dpi）抗性克隆H比易感克隆A+具有更低的病毒载量不同，在患病个体中，克隆H的病毒载量高于克隆A+。
text_zh: 与早期感染阶段（1-5 dpi）抗性克隆H比易感克隆A+具有更低的病毒载量不同，在患病个体中，克隆H的病毒载量高于克隆A+。
text_en: Unlike in the early infection stage (1-5 dpi), where resistant clone H had a lower viral load than susceptible clone A+, in diseased individuals, the viral load of clone H was higher than that of clone A+.

quote: resulting in cumulative mortalities of 98.89, 86.67 and 51.11% in clone A+, F and H.
statement: 在A+、F和H克隆中，累积死亡率分别为98.89%、86.67%和51.11%。
text_zh: 在A+、F和H克隆中，累积死亡率分别为98.89%、86.67%和51.11%。
text_en: In clones A+, F, and H, the cumulative mortality rates were 98.89%, 86.67%, and 51.11%, respectively.

quote: The survivors appeared healthy at 28 dpi.
statement: 幸存者在感染后28天看起来健康。
text_zh: 幸存者在感染后28天看起来健康。
text_en: Survivors appeared healthy 28 days after infection.

quote: These pieces of evidence suggested that the systemic neurotoxicity of crucian carp may be related to the upregulation of mRNA levels of GAD and GABA-T in various tissues treated with the lethal dose of DIF.
statement: 这些证据表明，经致死剂量DIF处理后，鲫鱼各组织中GAD和GABA-T mRNA水平的上调可能与全身性神经毒性有关。
text_zh: 这些证据表明，经致死剂量DIF处理后，鲫鱼各组织中GAD和GABA-T mRNA水平的上调可能与全身性神经毒性有关。
text_en: This evidence suggests that the upregulation of GAD and GABA-T mRNA levels in various tissues of crucian carp after treatment with a lethal dose of DIF may be associated with systemic neurotoxicity.

quote: This phenomenon may be a protective mechanism of stress resistance in crucian carp.
statement: 这种现象可能是鲫鱼的一种应激抗性保护机制。
text_zh: 这种现象可能是鲫鱼的一种应激抗性保护机制。
text_en: This phenomenon may be a stress resistance protective mechanism in crucian carp.

quote: Accompanied with rapid growth and high density aquaculture, gibel carp has been seriously threatened by Carassius auratus herpesvirus (Ca HV) since 2012.
statement: 快速生长和高密度养殖伴随着鲫鱼自2012年以来受到鲫疱疹病毒（Ca HV）的严重威胁。
text_zh: 快速生长和高密度养殖伴随着鲫鱼自2012年以来受到鲫疱疹病毒（Ca HV）的严重威胁。
text_en: Rapid growth and high-density farming have been accompanied by severe threats from crucian carp herpesvirus (Ca HV) to crucian carp since 2012.

quote: DEUs in cluster 3 showed higher increase levels in s-H vs c-H than those in s-A + vs c- A + , and most of them involved in immune reaction, such as mycbp , birc6 , klf13 and ifi44 .
statement: 第3簇中的差异表达单元在s-H与c-H比较中显示出比s-A+与c-A+比较中更高的增加水平，且其中大多数涉及免疫反应。
text_zh: 第3簇中的差异表达单元在s-H与c-H比较中显示出比s-A+与c-A+比较中更高的增加水平，且其中大多数涉及免疫反应。
text_en: Differentially expressed units in cluster 3 showed a higher level of increase in the s-H vs. c-H comparison than in the s-A+ vs. c-A+ comparison, and most of them were involved in immune response.

quote: However, the highly intensive farming has resulted in serious disease problems.
statement: 高密度养殖导致了严重的疾病问题。
text_zh: 高密度养殖导致了严重的疾病问题。
text_en: High-density farming led to serious disease problems.

quote: Especially, the infections of herpesvirus Ca HV in crucian carp (Carassius auratus), a newly emerged epizootic disease with acute gill hemorrhages and high mortality, has outbroken in main culture areas of Jiangsu province and caused huge economic losses since 2012 [ 19 ].
statement: 鲫鱼中的疱疹病毒Ca HV感染是一种新出现的流行病，具有急性鳃出血和高死亡率，自2012年以来在江苏省主要养殖区爆发并造成巨大经济损失。
text_zh: 鲫鱼中的疱疹病毒Ca HV感染是一种新出现的流行病，具有急性鳃出血和高死亡率，自2012年以来在江苏省主要养殖区爆发并造成巨大经济损失。
text_en: Carassius herpesvirus (Ca HV) infection in crucian carp is an emerging epidemic characterized by acute gill hemorrhage and high mortality, which has broken out in major aquaculture areas of Jiangsu Province since 2012, causing huge economic losses.

quote: The novel variety (clone F) [ 28 ], nominated as the allogynogenetic gibel carp “CAS V”, showed moderately resistant to Ca HV.
statement: 新品种（克隆F），被命名为异源雌核发育银鲫“CAS V”，显示出对Ca HV的中等抵抗力。
text_zh: 新品种（克隆F），被命名为异源雌核发育银鲫“CAS V”，显示出对Ca HV的中等抵抗力。
text_en: The new variety (Clone F), named allogynogenetic silver crucian carp "CAS V", showed moderate resistance to Ca HV.
intervention: Allogynogenetic silver crucian carp CAS V
intervention_record: 异源雌核发育银鲫CAS V

quote: GAD 65 , GAD 67 , and GABA-T levels both in the brain and peripheral tissues were significantly downregulated (P 50 (0.039 mg/L).
statement: 在AVM的半数致死浓度（LC50，0.039 mg/L）下，脑部和外周组织中的GAD 65、GAD 67和GABA-T水平均显著下调。
text_zh: 在AVM的半数致死浓度（LC50，0.039 mg/L）下，脑部和外周组织中的GAD 65、GAD 67和GABA-T水平均显著下调。
text_en: At the median lethal concentration (LC50, 0.039 mg/L) of AVM, GAD 65, GAD 67 and GABA-T levels in the brain and peripheral tissues were all significantly downregulated.

quote: The results suggest that both innate immune system and adaptive immune system persisted in activating in the survivors of resistant clone H after Ca HV challenge.
statement: 研究结果表明，在CaHV攻击后，抗性克隆H的存活者中先天免疫系统和适应性免疫系统持续激活。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，在CaHV攻击后，抗性克隆H的存活者中先天免疫系统和适应性免疫系统持续激活。
text_en: The results indicate that in survivors of resistant clone H following CaHV challenge, the innate immune system and adaptive immune system remained continuously activated.

quote: All procedures in this study were performed following the ethical requirements of Animal Care and Use Committee of Institute of Hydrobiology, Chinese Academy of Sciences to minimize animal suffering.
statement: 所有程序均遵循伦理要求以尽量减少动物痛苦。
text_zh: 所有程序均遵循伦理要求以尽量减少动物痛苦。
text_en: All procedures followed ethical requirements to minimize animal suffering.

quote: After deep and overdosed anesthesia with styrylpyridine (30-50 mg/L; aladdin, China), the fish were euthanized by immediately cutting off the spinal cord adjacent to the head.
statement: 鱼在过量苯乙烯吡啶麻醉后，通过切断头部附近的脊髓进行安乐死。
text_zh: 鱼在过量苯乙烯吡啶麻醉后，通过切断头部附近的脊髓进行安乐死。
text_en: Fish were euthanized by severing the spinal cord near the head after anesthesia with an overdose of styrylpyridine.

quote: susceptible clone A + failed to trigger IFN antiviral response but activated myosins to increase the virus release and spread (Table 3 ; Additional file 8 : Table S6), which resulted in the loss of battle between host and Ca HV and severely impaired circulatory system (Fig. 5 f).
statement: 易感克隆A+未能触发干扰素抗病毒反应，但激活了肌球蛋白以增加病毒释放和扩散，导致宿主与Ca HV之间的战斗失败并严重损害循环系统。
text_zh: 易感克隆A+未能触发干扰素抗病毒反应，但激活了肌球蛋白以增加病毒释放和扩散，导致宿主与Ca HV之间的战斗失败并严重损害循环系统。
text_en: Susceptible clone A+ failed to trigger an interferon antiviral response, but activated myosin to increase viral release and spread, leading to a failure in the battle between the host and Ca HV and severe damage to the circulatory system.

quote: Viral load were evaluated by real-time PCR as previously described [ 29 , 40 , 92 ].
statement: 病毒载量通过实时PCR进行评估，方法如前所述。
text_zh: 病毒载量通过实时PCR进行评估，方法如前所述。
text_en: Viral load was assessed by real-time PCR, as previously described.

quote: we set the A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 as the research target strain and try to explore the anti-virulence effect of YtnP protein from B. licheniformis T-1 against infection of A. hydrophila in Carassius auratus
statement: 本研究以嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966为目标菌株，试图探索来自地衣芽孢杆菌T-1的YtnP蛋白对鲫鱼中嗜水气单胞菌感染的抗毒力效果。
text_zh: 本研究以嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966为目标菌株，试图探索来自地衣芽孢杆菌T-1的YtnP蛋白对鲫鱼中嗜水气单胞菌感染的抗毒力效果。
text_en: This study used Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7966 as the target strain to explore the anti-virulence effect of YtnP protein from Bacillus licheniformis T-1 against Aeromonas hydrophila infection in crucian carp.

quote: This similar pattern of immune response was also been found in gilthead seabream (Sparus aurata L.) infected with lymphocystis disease virus (LCDV) [ 88 ].
statement: 这种类似的免疫反应模式也在感染淋巴囊肿病毒的鲷鱼中被发现。
text_zh: 这种类似的免疫反应模式也在感染淋巴囊肿病毒的鲷鱼中被发现。
text_en: A similar immune response pattern was also found in sea bream infected with lymphocystis disease virus.

quote: Owing to its highly intensive farming, the culture industry of crucian carp has suffered enormous economic losses caused by Ca HV.
statement: 由于高度集约化养殖，鲫鱼养殖业遭受了由鲤疱疹病毒（CaHV）造成的巨大经济损失。
text_zh: 由于高度集约化养殖，鲫鱼养殖业遭受了由鲤疱疹病毒（CaHV）造成的巨大经济损失。
text_en: Due to highly intensive farming, the crucian carp industry has suffered huge economic losses caused by Cyprinid herpesvirus (CaHV).

quote: The GO and KEGG analysis showed that the genes related to circulatory and immune system were activated in the survivors of all three gibel carp clones after Ca HV challenge (Figs. 2 and 3 and Tables 1 and 2).
statement: GO和KEGG分析显示，在CaHV攻击后，所有三个银鲫克隆的存活者中与循环系统和免疫系统相关的基因被激活。
text_zh: GO和KEGG分析显示，在CaHV攻击后，所有三个银鲫克隆的存活者中与循环系统和免疫系统相关的基因被激活。
text_en: GO and KEGG analysis showed that genes related to the circulatory system and immune system were activated in survivors of all three gibel carp clones after CaHV challenge.

quote: Minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of four kinds of antibiotics such as enrofloxacin, florfenicol, thiamphenicol, and doxycycline hydrochloride was determined against A. hydrophila by microdilution method
statement: 通过微量稀释法测定了四种抗生素（恩诺沙星、氟苯尼考、甲砜霉素和盐酸多西环素）对嗜水气单胞菌的最小抑菌浓度。
text_zh: 通过微量稀释法测定了四种抗生素（恩诺沙星、氟苯尼考、甲砜霉素和盐酸多西环素）对嗜水气单胞菌的最小抑菌浓度。
text_en: The minimum inhibitory concentrations of four antibiotics (enrofloxacin, florfenicol, thiamphenicol, and doxycycline hydrochloride) against Aeromonas hydrophila were determined by the microdilution method.

quote: The consequence of the synergistic effect of purified YtnP and antibiotics on MIC of A. hydrophila was determined according to the method of and concentration of the purified YtnP was 80 ng/μL.
statement: 根据特定方法确定了纯化YtnP与抗生素协同作用对嗜水气单胞菌最小抑菌浓度的影响，其中纯化YtnP的浓度为80 ng/μL。
text_zh: 根据特定方法确定了纯化YtnP与抗生素协同作用对嗜水气单胞菌最小抑菌浓度的影响，其中纯化YtnP的浓度为80 ng/μL。
text_en: The effect of the synergistic action of purified YtnP and antibiotics on the minimum inhibitory concentration of Aeromonas hydrophila was determined by a specific method, in which the concentration of purified YtnP was 80 ng/μL.

quote: The aerA , ahyB , hem , ast , ep of virulence gene of A. hydrophila were used to investigate the inhibition effect of YtnP.
statement: 利用嗜水气单胞菌的毒力基因aerA、ahyB、hem、ast和ep来研究YtnP的抑制效果。
text_zh: 利用嗜水气单胞菌的毒力基因aerA、ahyB、hem、ast和ep来研究YtnP的抑制效果。
text_en: The virulence genes aerA, ahyB, hem, ast and ep of Aeromonas hydrophila were used to study the inhibitory effect of YtnP.

quote: Different from the immediately up-regulated expression of IFN system genes in resistant clone H at 1 dpi, most of them were up-regulated at 3–5 dpi in susceptible clone A + [ 40 ], indicating that the delay of IFN response might affect the expression of IFN system genes in the survivors of susceptible clone A + .
statement: 与抗性克隆H在感染后1天立即上调干扰素系统基因不同，易感克隆A+中的大多数基因在感染后3-5天才上调，这表明干扰素反应的延迟可能会影响易感克隆A+存活个体中干扰素系统基因的表达。
text_zh: 与抗性克隆H在感染后1天立即上调干扰素系统基因不同，易感克隆A+中的大多数基因在感染后3-5天才上调，这表明干扰素反应的延迟可能会影响易感克隆A+存活个体中干扰素系统基因的表达。
text_en: Unlike the immediate upregulation of interferon system genes in resistant clone H at 1 day post-infection, most genes in susceptible clone A+ were upregulated only at 3-5 days post-infection, suggesting that the delay in the interferon response may affect the expression of interferon system genes in surviving individuals of susceptible clone A+.

quote: Aeromonas hydrophila is found in freshwater and seawater, mainly in freshwater culture environments, and causes a wide variety of symptoms in fish, including tissue swelling, necrosis, ulceration, and hemorrhagic septicemia [ 12 , 13 , 14 ].
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌存在于淡水和海水中，主要存在于淡水养殖环境中，并引起鱼类多种症状，包括组织肿胀、坏死、溃疡和出血性败血症。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌存在于淡水和海水中，主要存在于淡水养殖环境中，并引起鱼类多种症状，包括组织肿胀、坏死、溃疡和出血性败血症。
text_en: Aeromonas hydrophila exists in freshwater and seawater, is mainly found in freshwater aquaculture environments, and causes multiple symptoms in fish, including tissue swelling, necrosis, ulcers, and hemorrhagic septicemia.

quote: re randomly divided into four test groups injected intraperitoneally with 0.81 mg/mL YtnP (AHLase), 0.80 mg/mL YtnP + A. hydrophila of 10 8 CFU (AHLase + A. hydrophila), A. hydrophila of 10 8 CFU (A. hydrophila), and PBS buffer (control treatment) per fish in the volume of 1000 μL when anesthetized by tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222).
statement: 鱼被随机分为四组，分别腹腔注射YtnP、YtnP加嗜水气单胞菌、单独嗜水气单胞菌或PBS缓冲液，并在使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）麻醉时进行。
text_zh: 鱼被随机分为四组，分别腹腔注射YtnP、YtnP加嗜水气单胞菌、单独嗜水气单胞菌或PBS缓冲液，并在使用三卡因甲磺酸盐（MS-222）麻醉时进行。
text_en: Fish were randomly divided into four groups and intraperitoneally injected with YtnP, YtnP plus Aeromonas hydrophila, A. hydrophila alone, or PBS buffer, while being anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222).
outcome: 实验操作应激与麻醉管理

quote: The system was aerated, the dead specimens were taken out every day for routine bacteriological examination.
statement: 系统进行了曝气，每天取出死亡样本进行常规细菌学检查。
text_zh: 系统进行了曝气，每天取出死亡样本进行常规细菌学检查。
text_en: The system was aerated, and dead samples were removed daily for routine bacteriological examination.

quote: At a concentration of 80 ng/μL, YtnP showed a maximum of 68% reduction in the biofilm forming capability of A. hydrophila .
statement: 在80 ng/μL浓度下，YtnP使嗜水气单胞菌的生物膜形成能力最大降低了68%。
text_zh: 在80 ng/μL浓度下，YtnP使嗜水气单胞菌的生物膜形成能力最大降低了68%。
text_en: At a concentration of 80 ng/μL, YtnP reduced the biofilm formation ability of Aeromonas hydrophila by up to 68%.

quote: The 2-fold dilution of YtnP concentration on 40 ng/μL or 20 ng/μL, inhibition of A. hydrophila biofilm beyond 50%, and when the concentration of YtnP dropped below 5 ng/μL, the inhibition also reached more than 30%.
statement: 当YtnP浓度为40或20 ng/μL时，对嗜水气单胞菌生物膜的抑制超过50%；当浓度低于5 ng/μL时，抑制率仍达到30%以上。
text_zh: 当YtnP浓度为40或20 ng/μL时，对嗜水气单胞菌生物膜的抑制超过50%；当浓度低于5 ng/μL时，抑制率仍达到30%以上。
text_en: When the YtnP concentration was 40 or 20 ng/μL, the inhibition of Aeromonas hydrophila biofilm exceeded 50%; when the concentration was below 5 ng/μL, the inhibition rate still reached over 30%.

quote: Thus, YtnP had a significant inhibitory effect on the formation of BF in A. hydrophila
statement: 因此，YtnP对嗜水气单胞菌生物膜的形成具有显著的抑制作用。
text_zh: 因此，YtnP对嗜水气单胞菌生物膜的形成具有显著的抑制作用。
text_en: Therefore, YtnP has a significant inhibitory effect on the formation of Aeromonas hydrophila biofilms.

quote: C 7966 only (p B. licheniformis T-1 was proven to be YtnP protein and could be developed into an agent against infection of A. hydrophila in aquaculture.
statement: B. licheniformis T-1被证明是YtnP蛋白，并可开发为对抗水产养殖中嗜水气单胞菌感染的制剂。
text_zh: B. licheniformis T-1被证明是YtnP蛋白，并可开发为对抗水产养殖中嗜水气单胞菌感染的制剂。
text_en: B. licheniformis T-1 was shown to be the YtnP protein and can be developed as a preparation against Aeromonas hydrophila infection in aquaculture.

quote: The occurrence of bacterial diseases in the aquaculture industry has led to rising demand for biocontrol agents as an alternative to antibiotics.
statement: 水产养殖业细菌性疾病的发生导致了对作为抗生素替代品的生物防治剂的需求增加。
text_zh: 水产养殖业细菌性疾病的发生导致了对作为抗生素替代品的生物防治剂的需求增加。
text_en: The occurrence of bacterial diseases in aquaculture has led to an increased demand for biocontrol agents as alternatives to antibiotics.

quote: Previous studies have shown that pathogenic virulence factors are regulated by the quorum sensing (QS) system, through which information communication between them could be blocked to reduce the pathogenicity of the bacteria [ 2 , 3 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，致病性毒力因子受群体感应（QS）系统调节，通过阻断它们之间的信息交流可以降低细菌的致病性。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，致病性毒力因子受群体感应（QS）系统调节，通过阻断它们之间的信息交流可以降低细菌的致病性。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that pathogenic virulence factors are regulated by the quorum sensing (QS) system, and blocking the information exchange between them can reduce bacterial pathogenicity.

quote: Quorum quenching (QQ) interferes with the quorum sensing system to stop the infection by pathogens through inhibiting the synthesis and accumulation of signal molecules or by enzymatic degradation of signal molecules.
statement: 群体淬灭（QQ）通过抑制信号分子的合成和积累或通过酶降解信号分子来干扰群体感应系统，从而阻止病原体感染。
text_zh: 群体淬灭（QQ）通过抑制信号分子的合成和积累或通过酶降解信号分子来干扰群体感应系统，从而阻止病原体感染。
text_en: Quorum quenching (QQ) interferes with the quorum sensing system by inhibiting the synthesis and accumulation of signal molecules or by enzymatically degrading signal molecules, thereby preventing pathogen infection.

quote: Therefore, an anti-virulence strategy will become a potential approach against infections in the future.
statement: 因此，抗毒力策略将成为未来对抗感染的潜在方法。
text_zh: 因此，抗毒力策略将成为未来对抗感染的潜在方法。
text_en: Therefore, anti-virulence strategies will become a potential method for combating infections in the future.

quote: Anyway, these results indicated that YtnP, as the quorum quenching enzyme, could reduce the AHL accumulation of A. hydrophila , which would affect related gene expression and reduce the pathogenicity against A. hydrophila infection.
statement: 结果表明，作为群体淬灭酶的YtnP可以减少嗜水气单胞菌中AHL的积累，从而影响相关基因表达并降低致病性。
text_zh: 结果表明，作为群体淬灭酶的YtnP可以减少嗜水气单胞菌中AHL的积累，从而影响相关基因表达并降低致病性。
text_en: The results showed that YtnP, acting as a group quenching enzyme, can reduce the accumulation of AHLs in Aeromonas hydrophila, thereby affecting related gene expression and reducing pathogenicity.

quote: YtnP as a N -acyl homoserine lactone enzyme, had great potential application value on prevention and control bacterial diseases by way of anti-virulence.
statement: YtnP作为一种N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯酶，在通过抗毒力途径预防和控制细菌性疾病方面具有巨大的潜在应用价值。
text_zh: YtnP作为一种N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯酶，在通过抗毒力途径预防和控制细菌性疾病方面具有巨大的潜在应用价值。
text_en: YtnP, as an N-acyl homoserine lactonase, has great potential application value in preventing and controlling bacterial diseases through anti-virulence pathways.

quote: In this experiment, the quorum quenching gene ytnP of Bacillus licheniformis T-1 was cloned and expressed, and the effect against infection of Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7966 was evaluated in vitro and vivo.
statement: 本研究克隆并表达了地衣芽孢杆菌T-1的群体感应淬灭基因ytnP，并在体外和体内评估了其对抗嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966感染的效果。
text_zh: 本研究克隆并表达了地衣芽孢杆菌T-1的群体感应淬灭基因ytnP，并在体外和体内评估了其对抗嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966感染的效果。
text_en: This study cloned and expressed the quorum sensing quenching gene ytnP from Bacillus licheniformis T-1, and evaluated its effect against Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7966 infection in vitro and in vivo.

quote: Otherwise, purified YtnP protein could significantly inhibit the biofilm formation of A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 with an inhibition rate of 68%.
statement: 纯化的YtnP蛋白能显著抑制嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966的生物膜形成，抑制率为68%。
text_zh: 纯化的YtnP蛋白能显著抑制嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966的生物膜形成，抑制率为68%。
text_en: Purified YtnP protein significantly inhibited biofilm formation by Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7966, with an inhibition rate of 68%.

quote: In addition, YtnP significantly inhibited the expression of five virulence factors hem, ahyB, ast, ep, aerA of A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 as well
statement: 此外，YtnP还显著抑制了嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966五个毒力因子hem、ahyB、ast、ep、aerA的表达。
text_zh: 此外，YtnP还显著抑制了嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966五个毒力因子hem、ahyB、ast、ep、aerA的表达。
text_en: In addition, YtnP significantly inhibited the expression of five virulence factors (hem, ahyB, ast, ep, aerA) in Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7966.

quote: it attenuated the pathogenicity of A. hydrophila and the accumulated mortality was 27 ± 4.14% at 96 h, which was significantly lower than the average mortality of 78 ± 2.57% of the Carassius auratus injected with 10 8 CFU/mL of A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 only
statement: 它减弱了嗜水气单胞菌的致病性，96小时时的累积死亡率为27 ± 4.14%，显著低于仅注射10^8 CFU/mL嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966的金鱼平均死亡率78 ± 2.57%。
text_zh: 它减弱了嗜水气单胞菌的致病性，96小时时的累积死亡率为27 ± 4.14%，显著低于仅注射10^8 CFU/mL嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966的金鱼平均死亡率78 ± 2.57%。
text_en: It attenuated the pathogenicity of Aeromonas hydrophila, with a cumulative mortality rate of 27 ± 4.14% at 96 hours, which was significantly lower than the average mortality rate of 78 ± 2.57% in goldfish injected only with 10^8 CFU/mL Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7966.

quote: And so, a quorum-quenching strategy might efficiently control these pathogens against infection.
statement: 因此，群体感应淬灭策略可能有效地控制这些病原体以防止感染。
text_zh: 因此，群体感应淬灭策略可能有效地控制这些病原体以防止感染。
text_en: Therefore, quorum sensing inhibition strategies may effectively control these pathogens to prevent infection.

quote: Firstly, the inhibition effect of YtnP on A. hydrophila biofilms formation was quantified by crystallographic staining method.
statement: 首先，通过结晶紫染色法定量了 YtnP 对嗜水气单胞菌生物膜形成的抑制作用。
text_zh: 首先，通过结晶紫染色法定量了 YtnP 对嗜水气单胞菌生物膜形成的抑制作用。
text_en: First, the inhibitory effect of YtnP on biofilm formation by Aeromonas hydrophila was quantified using the crystal violet staining method.

quote: As a quorum-sensing quenching enzyme, the recombination YtnP protein could interfere with the bacterial communication by degrading the quorum-sensing signal molecular C6-HSL and break the development of A. hydrophila biofilm.
statement: 作为一种群体感应淬灭酶，重组 YtnP 蛋白可以通过降解群体感应信号分子 C6-HSL 来干扰细菌通讯，并破坏嗜水气单胞菌生物膜的发育。
text_zh: 作为一种群体感应淬灭酶，重组 YtnP 蛋白可以通过降解群体感应信号分子 C6-HSL 来干扰细菌通讯，并破坏嗜水气单胞菌生物膜的发育。
text_en: As a quorum quenching enzyme, recombinant YtnP protein can interfere with bacterial communication by degrading the quorum sensing signal molecule C6-HSL and disrupt the development of Aeromonas hydrophila biofilms.

quote: the gene expression quantity in A. hydrophila of the YtnP-treated group was significantly lower than that control groups
statement: YtnP处理组中嗜水气单胞菌的毒力基因表达量显著低于对照组。
text_zh: YtnP处理组中嗜水气单胞菌的毒力基因表达量显著低于对照组。
text_en: In the YtnP treatment group, the expression levels of virulence genes in Aeromonas hydrophila were significantly lower than those in the control group.

quote: N -acyl homoserine lactonase YtnP could down-regulate the expression of virulence genes in A. hydrophila .
statement: N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯酶YtnP可下调嗜水气单胞菌毒力基因的表达。
text_zh: N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯酶YtnP可下调嗜水气单胞菌毒力基因的表达。
text_en: The N-acyl homoserine lactonase YtnP can downregulate the expression of virulence genes in Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: In protection experiments, no pathogenic symptoms and mortalities were observed when intraperitoneal injection of sterile PBS buffer (groups A) or YtnP alone (Group B) for 96 h, the results suggested that the PBS and YtnP were not toxic to the fish.
statement: 腹腔注射无菌PBS缓冲液或单独注射YtnP在96小时内未观察到致病症状和死亡，表明PBS和YtnP对鱼无毒。
text_zh: 腹腔注射无菌PBS缓冲液或单独注射YtnP在96小时内未观察到致病症状和死亡，表明PBS和YtnP对鱼无毒。
text_en: No pathogenic symptoms or deaths were observed within 96 hours after intraperitoneal injection of sterile PBS buffer or YtnP alone, indicating that PBS and YtnP are non-toxic to fish.

quote: Moreover, antibiotics are widely used to stop infections caused by bacteria, in animal husbandry and aquaculture.
statement: 抗生素被广泛用于畜牧业和水产养殖中，以阻止由细菌引起的感染。
text_zh: 抗生素被广泛用于畜牧业和水产养殖中，以阻止由细菌引起的感染。
text_en: Antibiotics are widely used in livestock and aquaculture to prevent infections caused by bacteria.

quote: When injected intraperitoneally with A. hydrophila + YtnP, the accumulated mortality at 96 h was 27 ± 4.14%, significantly lower than the average mortality of 78 ± 2.57% of the C. auratus injected with 10 8 CFU/mL of A. hydrophila (p Figure 7).
statement: 与仅注射嗜水气单胞菌相比，腹腔注射嗜水气单胞菌加YtnP后，96小时的累积死亡率显著降低（27±4.14% vs 78±2.57%）。
text_zh: 与仅注射嗜水气单胞菌相比，腹腔注射嗜水气单胞菌加YtnP后，96小时的累积死亡率显著降低（27±4.14% vs 78±2.57%）。
text_en: Compared to injection with Aeromonas hydrophila alone, intraperitoneal injection of Aeromonas hydrophila plus YtnP significantly reduced the cumulative mortality at 96 hours (27±4.14% vs 78±2.57%).
intervention_record: YtnP与嗜水气单胞菌联合注射

quote: Co-injection of YtnP and A. hydrophila decreased the mortality rate of C. auratus by nearly 50%.
statement: 共同注射YtnP和嗜水气单胞菌使鲤鱼的死亡率降低了近50%。
text_zh: 共同注射YtnP和嗜水气单胞菌使鲤鱼的死亡率降低了近50%。
text_en: Co-injection of YtnP and Aeromonas hydrophila reduced the mortality rate of common carp by nearly 50%.
intervention_record: YtnP与嗜水气单胞菌联合注射

quote: The mortality of fish injected with A. hydrophila only was 30% at 16 h, and there was no fish dead within 16 h at the group of A. hydrophila + YtnP.
statement: 仅注射嗜水气单胞菌的鱼在16小时时死亡率为30%，而嗜水气单胞菌加YtnP组在16小时内没有鱼死亡。
text_zh: 仅注射嗜水气单胞菌的鱼在16小时时死亡率为30%，而嗜水气单胞菌加YtnP组在16小时内没有鱼死亡。
text_en: Fish injected with Aeromonas hydrophila alone had a mortality rate of 30% at 16 hours, while no fish died in the group treated with Aeromonas hydrophila plus YtnP within 16 hours.
intervention_record: YtnP与嗜水气单胞菌联合注射

quote: AHL degrading enzymes have been documented before as a promising way to prevent and control bacterial diseases in the agriculture and aquaculture industries [ 22 , 23 ].
statement: AHL降解酶此前已被记录为农业和水产养殖业中预防和控制细菌性疾病的一种有前途的方法。
text_zh: AHL降解酶此前已被记录为农业和水产养殖业中预防和控制细菌性疾病的一种有前途的方法。
text_en: AHL-degrading enzymes have previously been recorded as a promising method for the prevention and control of bacterial diseases in agriculture and aquaculture.

quote: Health Carassius auratus of 100 ± 5 g were raised at the density of 10 fish/tank (volume: 5 L/tank) in an indoor recirculation aquaculture system with daily aeration.
statement: 健康鲫鱼在室内循环水养殖系统中以每箱10尾（体积5升/箱）的密度饲养，并每日曝气。
text_zh: 健康鲫鱼在室内循环水养殖系统中以每箱10尾（体积5升/箱）的密度饲养，并每日曝气。
text_en: Healthy crucian carp were reared in an indoor recirculating aquaculture system at a density of 10 fish per tank (volume 5 L/tank), with daily aeration.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 28 ± 1 °C.
statement: 水温维持在28 ± 1 °C。
text_zh: 水温维持在28 ± 1 °C。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 28 ± 1 °C.

quote: Duplicated groups of eight C. auratus (100 ± 5 g, 10 cm ± 2 cm) were injected into the abdominal cavity with 1000 μL of A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 cell suspension at 5 × 10 5 –5 × 10 10 CFU/mL, and control groups were injected with the same volume of PBS (pH 7.3).
statement: 重复组每组八尾鲫鱼腹腔注射1000微升不同浓度的嗜水气单胞菌悬液，对照组注射等量PBS缓冲液。
text_zh: 重复组每组八尾鲫鱼腹腔注射1000微升不同浓度的嗜水气单胞菌悬液，对照组注射等量PBS缓冲液。
text_en: In the replicate groups, eight crucian carp per group were intraperitoneally injected with 1000 microliters of Aeromonas hydrophila suspension at different concentrations; the control group was injected with an equal volume of PBS buffer.

quote: The experimental fish was anesthetized with MS-222 at 80 mg/L.
statement: 实验鱼使用80毫克/升的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 实验鱼使用80毫克/升的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: The experimental fish were anesthetized using 80 mg/L of MS-222.

quote: To determine the effect of YtnP on A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 infection, C. auratus were randomly divided into four test groups injected intraperitoneally with 0.81 mg/mL YtnP (AHLase), 0.80 mg/mL YtnP + A. hydrophila of 10 8 CFU (AHLase + A. hydrophila), A. hydrophila of 10 8 CFU (A. hydrophila), and PBS buffer (control treatment) per fish in the volume of 1000 μL when anesthetized
statement: 为确定YtnP对嗜水气单胞菌感染的影响，将鲫鱼随机分为四组，在麻醉状态下腹腔注射YtnP、YtnP加细菌、仅细菌或PBS缓冲液。
text_zh: 为确定YtnP对嗜水气单胞菌感染的影响，将鲫鱼随机分为四组，在麻醉状态下腹腔注射YtnP、YtnP加细菌、仅细菌或PBS缓冲液。
text_en: To determine the effect of YtnP on Aeromonas hydrophila infection, crucian carp were randomly divided into four groups and intraperitoneally injected with YtnP, YtnP plus bacteria, bacteria only, or PBS buffer under anesthesia.

quote: It was interesting to observe that concentrations of Cr, Cu, Fe, Ni and Pb in the fish gut were at least two folds higher in Chitila and Floreasca lakes compared to Tei and Vacaresti lakes (Table 2).
statement: 观察到Chitila和Floreasca湖中鱼肠道的铬、铜、铁、镍和铅浓度比Tei和Vacaresti湖至少高出两倍。
text_zh: 观察到Chitila和Floreasca湖中鱼肠道的铬、铜、铁、镍和铅浓度比Tei和Vacaresti湖至少高出两倍。
text_en: Chromium, copper, iron, nickel and lead concentrations in the fish intestines of Lake Chitila and Lake Floreasca were observed to be at least twice as high as those in Lake Tei and Lake Vacaresti.

population.system: 野生/自然水体（布加勒斯特湖泊）

quote: In urban areas, water surfaces are most often polluted, with many negative consequences, affecting the living organisms (including fish), by generating a toxic environment, which can lead to alteration of their vital functions, and even death.
statement: 城市地区的水面经常受到污染，产生有毒环境，影响包括鱼类在内的生物体，导致其生命功能改变甚至死亡。
text_zh: 城市地区的水面经常受到污染，产生有毒环境，影响包括鱼类在内的生物体，导致其生命功能改变甚至死亡。
text_en: Water surfaces in urban areas are often polluted, creating toxic environments that affect organisms including fish, leading to changes in their life functions or even death.

quote: Numerous studies on fish have suggested that high levels of pollution cause oxidative stress in the tissues of various organs, including the gut through the contact with ingested, contaminated water [ 7 , 8 , 9 ].
statement: 大量关于鱼类的研究表明，高水平的污染会导致各种器官组织（包括肠道）产生氧化应激，这是通过接触摄入的受污染水引起的。
text_zh: 大量关于鱼类的研究表明，高水平的污染会导致各种器官组织（包括肠道）产生氧化应激，这是通过接触摄入的受污染水引起的。
text_en: A large body of research on fish indicates that high levels of pollution cause oxidative stress in various organ tissues (including the intestine), which is induced by exposure to ingested contaminated water.

quote: Recently, it was demonstrated that anthropogenic waste in the aquatic environment has an impact on the gut microbiome composition in fish, which affects the health state of fishes from physiological and immunological point of view [ 10 ].
statement: 最近的研究证明，水生环境中的人为废物会影响鱼类的肠道微生物组组成，从而从生理和免疫角度影响鱼类的健康状况。
text_zh: 最近的研究证明，水生环境中的人为废物会影响鱼类的肠道微生物组组成，从而从生理和免疫角度影响鱼类的健康状况。
text_en: Recent studies have demonstrated that anthropogenic waste in aquatic environments affects the composition of fish gut microbiota, thereby influencing fish health from physiological and immunological perspectives.
outcome: 肠道微生物组与健康状态

quote: Fish are able to accumulate by ingestion various contaminants of aquatic environment, with negative consequences on their intestine
statement: 鱼类通过摄入积累各种水生环境污染物，对其肠道产生负面影响。
text_zh: 鱼类通过摄入积累各种水生环境污染物，对其肠道产生负面影响。
text_en: Fish accumulate various aquatic environmental pollutants through ingestion, which negatively affects their intestines.

quote: being continuously threatened worldwide by heavy metals, pesticides and antibiotics resulted from the human activities.
statement: 鱼类受到源自人类活动的重金属、农药和抗生素的持续威胁。
text_zh: 鱼类受到源自人类活动的重金属、农药和抗生素的持续威胁。
text_en: Fish are under continuous threat from heavy metals, pesticides, and antibiotics originating from human activities.

quote: Our results showed that fish from Bucharest lakes designed for leisure (Chitila, Floreasca and Tei lakes) have an increased level of oxidative stress in intestine tissue, revealed by affected antioxidant enzymes activities and GSH levels, as well as the high degree of lipid peroxidation, compared to the fish from protected environment (Vacaresti Lake).
statement: 结果显示，与来自受保护环境（Vacaresti湖）的鱼相比，来自布加勒斯特休闲湖泊（Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖）的鱼肠道组织中的氧化应激水平增加，表现为抗氧化酶活性和GSH水平受影响以及脂质过氧化程度高。
text_zh: 结果显示，与来自受保护环境（Vacaresti湖）的鱼相比，来自布加勒斯特休闲湖泊（Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖）的鱼肠道组织中的氧化应激水平增加，表现为抗氧化酶活性和GSH水平受影响以及脂质过氧化程度高。
text_en: The results showed that, compared to fish from a protected environment (Vacaresti Lake), fish from recreational lakes in Bucharest (Chitila, Floreasca and Tei Lakes) had increased oxidative stress levels in intestinal tissue, manifested as affected antioxidant enzyme activity and GSH levels and high lipid peroxidation.

quote: Some heavy metals (Fe, Ni and Pb) and pesticides (aldrin and dieldrin) were in high amount in the gut of fish with modified antioxidative status.
statement: 具有改变抗氧化状态的鱼的肠道中含有大量的某些重金属（铁、镍和铅）和农药（艾氏剂和狄氏剂）。
text_zh: 具有改变抗氧化状态的鱼的肠道中含有大量的某些重金属（铁、镍和铅）和农药（艾氏剂和狄氏剂）。
text_en: The intestines of fish with altered antioxidant status contain large amounts of certain heavy metals (iron, nickel and lead) and pesticides (aldrin and dieldrin).
outcome: 污染物积累与生理状态关联

quote: The degree of lipid peroxidation was determined by reporting the MDA level from each sample to the corresponding protein concentration (nmols MDA/mg protein).
statement: 脂质过氧化程度通过报告每个样品的MDA水平与相应的蛋白质浓度（nmol MDA/mg蛋白）来确定。
text_zh: 脂质过氧化程度通过报告每个样品的MDA水平与相应的蛋白质浓度（nmol MDA/mg蛋白）来确定。
text_en: The degree of lipid peroxidation was determined by reporting the MDA level of each sample relative to its corresponding protein concentration (nmol MDA/mg protein).

quote: Hence, lower alpha diversity (also known as intra-individual diversity) is an indicator of an unbalanced microbiome.
statement: 较低的α多样性（即个体内多样性）是微生物组失衡的指标。
text_zh: 较低的α多样性（即个体内多样性）是微生物组失衡的指标。
text_en: Lower alpha diversity (i.e., within-individual diversity) is an indicator of microbiome imbalance.

quote: Regarding the Fe, Ni, Pb concentrations in gut tissue from fish in the Romanian lakes, the results were significantly higher (up to 4–5 folds) than those from China and Lithuania [ 20 , 21 ].
statement: 罗马尼亚湖泊鱼类肠道组织中的铁、镍和铅浓度显著高于中国和立陶宛的研究结果（高达4-5倍）。
text_zh: 罗马尼亚湖泊鱼类肠道组织中的铁、镍和铅浓度显著高于中国和立陶宛的研究结果（高达4-5倍）。
text_en: Iron, nickel, and lead concentrations in the intestinal tissue of fish from Romanian lakes were significantly higher than those reported in studies from China and Lithuania (up to 4-5 times higher).

quote: The overall metal concentrations found in fish guts were not susceptible to induce major toxic effects in Cyprinus carpio [ 22 ].
statement: 在鱼肠道中发现的总体金属浓度不足以对鲤鱼诱发主要的毒性效应。
text_zh: 在鱼肠道中发现的总体金属浓度不足以对鲤鱼诱发主要的毒性效应。
text_en: The overall metal concentrations found in fish intestines are insufficient to induce major toxic effects in carp.

quote: Table 3 shows the presence of Dieldrin, 2,4′ DDE, 4,4′ DDE and 2,4′-Methoxychlor in all collected fish samples.
statement: 所有采集的鱼类样本中均检测到狄氏剂、2,4'-DDE、4,4'-DDE和2,4'-甲氧氯的存在。
text_zh: 所有采集的鱼类样本中均检测到狄氏剂、2,4'-DDE、4,4'-DDE和2,4'-甲氧氯的存在。
text_en: Dieldrin, 2,4'-DDE, 4,4'-DDE and 2,4'-methoxychlor were detected in all collected fish samples.

quote: when the C. auratus were intraperitoneally injected with A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 and YtnP, the accumulated mortality at 96 h was 27 ± 4.14%, which was significantly lower than the average mortality of 78 ± 2.57% of the C. auratus injected with 10 8 CFU of A. hydrophila in control groups
statement: 注射YtnP酶和嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼在96小时内的累积死亡率显著低于仅注射嗜水气单胞菌的对照组。
text_zh: 注射YtnP酶和嗜水气单胞菌的鲫鱼在96小时内的累积死亡率显著低于仅注射嗜水气单胞菌的对照组。
text_en: The cumulative mortality of crucian carp injected with YtnP enzyme and Aeromonas hydrophila within 96 hours was significantly lower than that of the control group injected only with Aeromonas hydrophila.

quote: Hence, YtnP enzyme, both in vivo and in vitro, had shown that it could enhance the protective effect on aquatic animals infected with A. hydrophila by attenuating the expression of virulence factors.
statement: YtnP酶通过减弱毒力因子的表达，增强了对感染嗜水气单胞菌的水生动物的保护效果。
text_zh: YtnP酶通过减弱毒力因子的表达，增强了对感染嗜水气单胞菌的水生动物的保护效果。
text_en: YtnP enzyme enhanced the protective effect against infection by Aeromonas hydrophila in aquatic animals by attenuating the expression of virulence factors.

quote: In addition, after injected with the YtnP enzyme alone, the C. auratus displayed no signs of stress or disease, and no mortalities were observed (Figure 7), which indicated that the YtnP enzyme was safe from applications.
statement: 单独注射YtnP酶的鲫鱼未表现出应激或疾病迹象，且无死亡，表明该酶应用安全。
text_zh: 单独注射YtnP酶的鲫鱼未表现出应激或疾病迹象，且无死亡，表明该酶应用安全。
text_en: Crucian carp injected with YtnP enzyme alone did not show signs of stress or disease, and there were no deaths, indicating that the application of this enzyme is safe.

quote: Especially, survival of the group injected with the combination of YtnP and A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 was 100% at 0–16 h in the present experiment; otherwise, the death of the control group injected with A. hydrophila ATCC 7966 only occurred at the 4th hour, which was significantly earlier than the experimental group.
statement: 联合注射YtnP和嗜水气单胞菌的实验组在0-16小时内存活率为100%，而对照组的死亡发生在第4小时，显著早于实验组。
text_zh: 联合注射YtnP和嗜水气单胞菌的实验组在0-16小时内存活率为100%，而对照组的死亡发生在第4小时，显著早于实验组。
text_en: The experimental group co-injected with YtnP and Aeromonas hydrophila had a survival rate of 100% within 0-16 hours, while deaths in the control group occurred at hour 4, significantly earlier than in the experimental group.
intervention_record: YtnP与嗜水气单胞菌联合注射

quote: Based on this analysis, we can speculate that the best protection stage of the YtnPprotein against infection of A. hydrophila might be in the early infection, which suggested that YtnP protein could be used as the prophylactic agents in aquaculture practices.
statement: 推测YtnP蛋白对嗜水气单胞菌感染的最佳保护阶段可能在感染早期，建议其可作为水产养殖中的预防剂使用。
text_zh: 推测YtnP蛋白对嗜水气单胞菌感染的最佳保护阶段可能在感染早期，建议其可作为水产养殖中的预防剂使用。
text_en: It is speculated that the optimal protective stage of YtnP protein against Aeromonas hydrophila infection may be in the early stage of infection, and it is suggested that it can be used as a prophylactic agent in aquaculture.

quote: We speculated that the interference with biofilm formation could decrease the doses of the antibiotics, there are still differences contraposed to different antibiotics and which need more investigation to explore the working mechanism.
statement: 作者推测干扰生物膜形成可能减少抗生素剂量，但不同抗生素之间存在差异，需要进一步研究以探索其工作机制。
text_zh: 作者推测干扰生物膜形成可能减少抗生素剂量，但不同抗生素之间存在差异，需要进一步研究以探索其工作机制。
text_en: The authors speculate that disrupting biofilm formation may reduce antibiotic doses, but there are differences between antibiotics, and further research is needed to explore its mechanism of action.
limitations: 不同抗生素间存在差异

quote: Thus, to interfere with the QS system, reduce the expression of virulence factors could control the occurrence of aquatic diseases caused by A. hydrophila [ 27 , 34 , 35 ].
statement: 因此，干扰群体感应系统以减少毒力因子的表达可以控制由嗜水气单胞菌引起的水生动物疾病的发生。
text_zh: 因此，干扰群体感应系统以减少毒力因子的表达可以控制由嗜水气单胞菌引起的水生动物疾病的发生。
text_en: Therefore, disrupting the quorum sensing system to reduce the expression of virulence factors can control the occurrence of aquatic animal diseases caused by Aeromonas hydrophila.

text_zh: 体外结果也响应了体内攻毒试验，当金鱼腹腔注射嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7966和YtnP时，96小时的累积死亡率...
text_en: In vitro results also responded to the in vivo challenge test. When goldfish were intraperitoneally injected with Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7966 and YtnP, the cumulative mortality at 96 hours...

quote: Reduced glutathione (GSH) level was assessed using Sigma’s Glutathione Assay Kit (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA)
statement: 还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平使用Sigma公司的谷胱甘肽检测试剂盒进行评估。
text_zh: 还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）水平使用Sigma公司的谷胱甘肽检测试剂盒进行评估。
text_en: Reduced glutathione (GSH) levels were assessed using a glutathione assay kit from Sigma.

quote: In general, our data showed that supplementation with CGA in dietary had a positive effect on Carassius auratus growth, immunity, and balance of the bacteria in the intestine.
statement: 总体而言，数据显示膳食中添加CGA对鲫鱼的生长、免疫力和肠道细菌平衡有积极影响。
text_zh: 总体而言，数据显示膳食中添加CGA对鲫鱼的生长、免疫力和肠道细菌平衡有积极影响。
text_en: Overall, the data show that dietary addition of CGA has positive effects on the growth, immunity, and gut bacterial balance of crucian carp.

quote: Chinese herbal medicine, as a natural and innocuous compound, has been used for replacing antibiotics to prevent and control fish diseases (Santos and Ramos, 2016 ; Zhang et al., 2022).
statement: 中草药作为一种天然无毒化合物，已被用于替代抗生素以预防和控制鱼类疾病。
text_zh: 中草药作为一种天然无毒化合物，已被用于替代抗生素以预防和控制鱼类疾病。
text_en: Chinese herbal medicine, as a natural non-toxic compound, has been used to replace antibiotics for the prevention and control of fish diseases.

quote: On the other hand, fish from Floreasca Lake presented the lowest total SOD activity due to the highest iron content in gut, which is in accordance with previous report [ 35 ].
statement: 另一方面，来自Floreasca湖的鱼由于肠道中铁含量最高而表现出最低的总SOD活性，这与之前的报告一致。
text_zh: 另一方面，来自Floreasca湖的鱼由于肠道中铁含量最高而表现出最低的总SOD活性，这与之前的报告一致。
text_en: On the other hand, fish from Lake Floreasca exhibited the lowest total SOD activity due to having the highest iron content in their intestines, which is consistent with previous reports.

quote: Having an important role in detoxification, these low levels of GST might suggest an inhibition of the this enzyme’s activity, most likely explained by the high level of several heavy metals (Cr, Cu, Fe, Ni and Fe) (Table 2) that accumulated in the gut of fish found in Chitila, Floreasca and Tei lakes compared to the fish living in the protected environment of Vacaresti Lake [ 36 , 37 ].
statement: 低水平的GST可能暗示该酶活性的抑制，这最有可能由与生活在受保护环境的Vacaresti湖中的鱼相比，在Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖中发现的鱼肠道中积累的几种重金属（Cr、Cu、Fe、Ni和Fe）的高水平所解释。
text_zh: 低水平的GST可能暗示该酶活性的抑制，这最有可能由与生活在受保护环境的Vacaresti湖中的鱼相比，在Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖中发现的鱼肠道中积累的几种重金属（Cr、Cu、Fe、Ni和Fe）的高水平所解释。
text_en: Low levels of GST may suggest inhibition of this enzyme activity, which is most likely explained by the high levels of several heavy metals (Cr, Cu, Fe, Ni and Fe) accumulated in the intestines of fish found in Chitila, Floreasca and Tei lakes compared to fish living in the protected environment of Vacaresti lake.

quote: Our study showed that feeding CGA had a significant positive effect on the growth, immunity, and gut flora balance of Carassius auratus .
statement: 本研究表明，饲喂绿原酸对鲫鱼的生长、免疫力和肠道菌群平衡有显著的积极影响。
text_zh: 本研究表明，饲喂绿原酸对鲫鱼的生长、免疫力和肠道菌群平衡有显著的积极影响。
text_en: This study shows that feeding chlorogenic acid has significant positive effects on the growth, immunity, and gut microbiota balance of crucian carp.
outcome: 生长、免疫力及肠道菌群平衡

quote: Our findings provide a reference for the strategy of CGA replacing some chemical drugs and antibiotics to prevent and control fish diseases, which is of great significance to healthy aquaculture and ecological environmental protection.
statement: 研究结果提供了用绿原酸替代部分化学药物和抗生素以预防和控制鱼类疾病的策略参考，这对健康水产养殖和生态环境保护具有重要意义。
text_zh: 研究结果提供了用绿原酸替代部分化学药物和抗生素以预防和控制鱼类疾病的策略参考，这对健康水产养殖和生态环境保护具有重要意义。
text_en: The research results provide a strategic reference for using chlorogenic acid to replace some chemical drugs and antibiotics to prevent and control fish diseases, which is of great significance for healthy aquaculture and ecological environment protection.
intervention_record: 绿原酸替代药物和抗生素

quote: Fish are often exposed to heavily polluted water, which causes biochemical changes in the cells or changes in the whole body.
statement: 鱼类经常暴露于严重污染的水中，这会导致细胞内的生化变化或全身性的变化。
text_zh: 鱼类经常暴露于严重污染的水中，这会导致细胞内的生化变化或全身性的变化。
text_en: Fish are frequently exposed to severely polluted water, which leads to biochemical changes within cells or systemic changes.

statement: 研究结果显示，与来自受保护环境（Vacaresti湖）的鱼类相比，来自布加勒斯特休闲湖泊（Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖）的鱼类肠道组织中的氧化应激水平升高，表现为抗氧化酶活性和GSH水平受影响以及脂质过氧化程度高。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，与来自受保护环境（Vacaresti湖）的鱼类相比，来自布加勒斯特休闲湖泊（Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖）的鱼类肠道组织中的氧化应激水平升高，表现为抗氧化酶活性和GSH水平受影响以及脂质过氧化程度高。
text_en: The study results showed that, compared to fish from a protected environment (Vacaresti Lake), fish from recreational lakes in Bucharest (Chitila, Floreasca and Tei Lakes) had elevated levels of oxidative stress in intestinal tissue, manifested as affected antioxidant enzyme activity and GSH levels, and high lipid peroxidation.

quote: These changes could have serious negative consequences for the health and even survival of these organisms.
statement: 这些变化可能对这些生物的健康甚至生存产生严重的负面后果。
text_zh: 这些变化可能对这些生物的健康甚至生存产生严重的负面后果。
text_en: These changes may have serious negative consequences for the health or even survival of these organisms.

quote: In addition, these findings could be very well correlated with the presence of some heavy metals (Fe, Ni and Pb) and pesticides (Aldrin and Dieldrin) in high amount in the gut of fish with modified antioxidative status.
statement: 此外，这些发现可能与具有改变后的抗氧化状态的鱼类肠道中存在大量某些重金属（Fe、Ni和Pb）和农药（艾氏剂和狄氏剂）很好地相关。
text_zh: 此外，这些发现可能与具有改变后的抗氧化状态的鱼类肠道中存在大量某些重金属（Fe、Ni和Pb）和农药（艾氏剂和狄氏剂）很好地相关。
text_en: In addition, these findings may be well correlated with the presence of large amounts of certain heavy metals (Fe, Ni, and Pb) and pesticides (aldrin and dieldrin) in the fish gut with altered antioxidant status.
outcome: 污染物暴露与生理状态关联

quote: In our study, the intestinal lipase and amylase activities of the CGA-added group were significantly higher than those of the control group, P = 0.00007 and P = 0.0012, respectively (Figure 1), indicating that adding CGA to the feed could improve the ability of secretion of intestinal lipase and amylase, and enhance the digestion level of fat and starch in Carassius auratus .
statement: 本研究中，添加绿原酸组的肠道脂肪酶和淀粉酶活性显著高于对照组，表明在饲料中添加绿原酸可以提高肠道脂肪酶和淀粉酶的分泌能力，并增强鲫鱼对脂肪和淀粉的消化水平。
text_zh: 本研究中，添加绿原酸组的肠道脂肪酶和淀粉酶活性显著高于对照组，表明在饲料中添加绿原酸可以提高肠道脂肪酶和淀粉酶的分泌能力，并增强鲫鱼对脂肪和淀粉的消化水平。
text_en: In this study, the intestinal lipase and amylase activities in the chlorogenic acid-supplemented group were significantly higher than those in the control group, indicating that adding chlorogenic acid to feed can improve the secretion capacity of intestinal lipase and amylase and enhance the digestion level of fat and starch in crucian carp.

quote: The increased degree of lipid peroxidation in the gut, quantified by the level of MDA, was indicated by values higher in the gut samples of fish from the Chitila, Floreasca and Tei lakes compared to the concentration identified in the fish from Vacaresti Lake.
statement: Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖鱼肠道样本中的MDA值高于Vacaresti湖的鱼，表明这些湖泊中鱼的肠道脂质过氧化程度增加。
text_zh: Chitila、Floreasca和Tei湖鱼肠道样本中的MDA值高于Vacaresti湖的鱼，表明这些湖泊中鱼的肠道脂质过氧化程度增加。
text_en: MDA values in fish intestinal samples from Lake Chitila, Floreasca and Tei were higher than those in fish from Lake Vacaresti, indicating increased intestinal lipid peroxidation in fish from these lakes.

quote: The lowest level of MDA in the gut of fish from Vacaresti Lake could be correlated with the highest activities of GPX and GST, enzymes involved in lipid peroxides’ detoxification.
statement: Vacaresti湖鱼肠道中最低的MDA水平可能与参与脂质过氧化物解毒的GPX和GST酶的最高活性相关。
text_zh: Vacaresti湖鱼肠道中最低的MDA水平可能与参与脂质过氧化物解毒的GPX和GST酶的最高活性相关。
text_en: The lowest MDA levels in the gut of Vacaresti lake fish may be associated with the highest activity of GPX and GST enzymes involved in lipid peroxide detoxification.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性与脂质过氧化控制

quote: supplementation of CGA in the fish diet significantly increased the abundance of Firmicutes (from 2.00 to 31.27%, p = 0.027) and decreased the abundance of Proteobacteria (from 89.95 to 29.29%, p = 0.033)
statement: 在鱼饲料中添加绿原酸显著增加了厚壁菌门的丰度，并降低了变形菌门的丰度。
text_zh: 在鱼饲料中添加绿原酸显著增加了厚壁菌门的丰度，并降低了变形菌门的丰度。
text_en: Adding chlorogenic acid to fish feed significantly increased the abundance of Firmicutes and decreased the abundance of Proteobacteria.

quote: the antioxidant indices including superoxide dismutase (SOD), peroxidase (POD), reduced glutathione (GSH), and malondialdehyde (MDA) concentration of gut, muscle, and liver tissues, the TG concentration in muscle and liver, and the non-specific immune enzyme activities including acid phosphatase (ACP), alkaline phosphatase (AKP) in gut and liver tissues were determined with commercially assay kits
statement: 抗氧化指标（包括SOD、POD、GSH和MDA浓度）、甘油三酯（TG）浓度以及非特异性免疫酶活性（包括ACP和AKP）通过商业试剂盒进行测定。
text_zh: 抗氧化指标（包括SOD、POD、GSH和MDA浓度）、甘油三酯（TG）浓度以及非特异性免疫酶活性（包括ACP和AKP）通过商业试剂盒进行测定。
text_en: Antioxidant indicators (including SOD, POD, GSH and MDA concentrations), triglyceride (TG) concentration, and non-specific immune enzyme activities (including ACP and AKP) were determined using commercial kits.

quote: The experiment was carried out in fish tanks with 1 m 3 with identical management including water inputs, daily water exchange rate (∼5%), feed type, and rearing schedule.
statement: 实验在1立方米的水箱中进行，管理条件相同，包括进水、每日换水率（约5%）、饲料类型和饲养计划。
text_zh: 实验在1立方米的水箱中进行，管理条件相同，包括进水、每日换水率（约5%）、饲料类型和饲养计划。
text_en: The experiment was conducted in 1 cubic meter tanks, with identical management conditions, including water inflow, daily water exchange rate (about 5%), feed type and rearing schedule.

quote: The larval fish were cultured at a stocking density of ∼60 individuals per tank.
statement: 幼鱼以每箱约60尾的密度进行养殖。
text_zh: 幼鱼以每箱约60尾的密度进行养殖。
text_en: Juvenile fish were reared at a density of about 60 individuals per tank.

quote: All the fish were fed a commercial non-medicated feed (Tongwei Co., Ltd.) for 15 days, two times per day at 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.
statement: 所有鱼在15天内每天两次（上午9点和下午5点）喂食商业非药物饲料。
text_zh: 所有鱼在15天内每天两次（上午9点和下午5点）喂食商业非药物饲料。
text_en: All fish were fed commercial non-medicated feed twice daily (at 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.) for 15 days.

quote: Compared with the control group, the antioxidant GSH in intestinal, muscle, and liver tissue of the CGA-added group were all increased (Figures 5B,F,J).
statement: 与对照组相比，添加CGA组的肠道、肌肉和肝脏组织中的抗氧化剂GSH均增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，添加CGA组的肠道、肌肉和肝脏组织中的抗氧化剂GSH均增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, GSH (an antioxidant) increased in the intestinal, muscle, and liver tissues of the CGA-supplemented group.

quote: Additionally, the activities of POD and total SOD in the CGA-added group were higher than those in the control group (Figures 5C,D,G,H,K,L).
statement: 此外，添加CGA组中POD和总SOD的活性高于对照组。
text_zh: 此外，添加CGA组中POD和总SOD的活性高于对照组。
text_en: In addition, the activities of POD and total SOD in the CGA-supplemented group were higher than those in the control group.

quote: In our study, we found that when CGA was added to the fish diet, MDA content in multiple tissues was reduced (Figures 5A,E,I).
statement: 研究发现，当在鱼饲料中添加绿原酸时，多种组织中的MDA含量降低。
text_zh: 研究发现，当在鱼饲料中添加绿原酸时，多种组织中的MDA含量降低。
text_en: The study found that when chlorogenic acid was added to fish feed, MDA content decreased in multiple tissues.

quote: Especially, the content of MDA in the liver tissue was significantly lower than that in the control group (P = 0.000012).
statement: 特别是，肝组织中的MDA含量显著低于对照组。
text_zh: 特别是，肝组织中的MDA含量显著低于对照组。
text_en: In particular, the MDA content in liver tissue was significantly lower than that of the control group.

quote: This could indicate the stimulation of this enzyme’s activity in order to remove reactive oxygen species generated by diverse aquatic pollutants.
statement: 这可能表明为了去除由各种水生污染物产生的活性氧而刺激了该酶的活性。
text_zh: 这可能表明为了去除由各种水生污染物产生的活性氧而刺激了该酶的活性。
text_en: This may indicate that the activity of this enzyme was stimulated to remove reactive oxygen species produced by various aquatic pollutants.

quote: Furthermore, this could be correlated with the high level of MDA in the intestine of individuals from Floreasca Lake compared to those from Vacaresti Lake (Figure 2 B).
statement: 此外，这可能与来自Floreasca湖个体肠道中MDA水平高于来自Vacaresti湖个体的情况相关。
text_zh: 此外，这可能与来自Floreasca湖个体肠道中MDA水平高于来自Vacaresti湖个体的情况相关。
text_en: In addition, this may be related to the higher intestinal MDA levels in individuals from Floreasca Lake compared to those from Vacaresti Lake.

quote: Regarding the GR activity, the highest level was noticed also in the fish of Vacaresti Lake, compared to the level found in individuals from the other three lakes.
statement: 关于GR活性，与在其他三个湖泊中发现的个体水平相比，也在Vacaresti湖的鱼中注意到最高水平。
text_zh: 关于GR活性，与在其他三个湖泊中发现的个体水平相比，也在Vacaresti湖的鱼中注意到最高水平。
text_en: Regarding GR activity, the highest levels were also noted in fish from Lake Vacaresti compared to individual levels found in the other three lakes.

quote: GSH, the most important non-enzymatic antioxidant, showed an increased level in the samples from Chitila and Floreasca lakes compared to those from Vacaresti Lake (Figure 2 A).
statement: 最重要的非酶抗氧化剂GSH在来自Chitila和Floreasca湖的样本中显示出比来自Vacaresti湖的样本更高的水平。
text_zh: 最重要的非酶抗氧化剂GSH在来自Chitila和Floreasca湖的样本中显示出比来自Vacaresti湖的样本更高的水平。
text_en: The most important non-enzymatic antioxidant, GSH, showed higher levels in samples from Chitila and Floreasca lakes than in samples from Vacaresti lake.

quote: Compared with the control group, ACP (P = 0.000006) and AKP (P = 0.003627) activities in the CGA-added group were significantly increased in the intestinal tissue
statement: 与对照组相比，添加CGA组的肠道组织中酸性磷酸酶（ACP）和碱性磷酸酶（AKP）活性显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，添加CGA组的肠道组织中酸性磷酸酶（ACP）和碱性磷酸酶（AKP）活性显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the activities of acid phosphatase (ACP) and alkaline phosphatase (AKP) in intestinal tissue were significantly increased in the chlorogenic acid (CGA)-supplemented group.

quote: In general, it showed that CGA could improve the liver and intestinal non-specific immunity of Carassius auratus .
statement: 总体而言，这表明CGA可以改善鲫鱼的肝脏和肠道非特异性免疫力。
text_zh: 总体而言，这表明CGA可以改善鲫鱼的肝脏和肠道非特异性免疫力。
text_en: Overall, this indicates that CGA can improve the non-specific immunity of the liver and intestine in crucian carp.

quote: Intestinal villi in the CGA-added group were arranged orderly and closely, while sparse and shorter in the control group.
statement: 添加CGA组的肠绒毛排列整齐紧密，而对照组的肠绒毛稀疏且较短。
text_zh: 添加CGA组的肠绒毛排列整齐紧密，而对照组的肠绒毛稀疏且较短。
text_en: The intestinal villi in the group supplemented with CGA were neatly and tightly arranged, whereas those in the control group were sparse and shorter.

quote: Meanwhile, there were slightly more goblet cells in the CGA-added group than in the control group
statement: 同时，添加CGA组的杯状细胞数量略多于对照组。
text_zh: 同时，添加CGA组的杯状细胞数量略多于对照组。
text_en: At the same time, the number of goblet cells in the group supplemented with CGA was slightly higher than that in the control group.

quote: All fish were reared in water tanks that included a biological filter with recirculating water for 4 weeks.
statement: 所有鱼在装有生物过滤器的循环水水箱中饲养了4周。
text_zh: 所有鱼在装有生物过滤器的循环水水箱中饲养了4周。
text_en: All fish were kept for 4 weeks in recirculating water tanks equipped with biological filters.

population.species: 青波 (Spinibarbus sinensis) 和鲫鱼 (Carassius auratus)

quote: As a Chinese herbal medicine, leaf extract chlorogenic acid (CGA) of Eucommia ulmoides Oliver can improve animal immunity and antioxidant capacity and can improve animal production performance.
statement: 绿原酸（CGA）作为中药，可以提高动物的免疫力和抗氧化能力，并改善生产性能。
text_zh: 绿原酸（CGA）作为中药，可以提高动物的免疫力和抗氧化能力，并改善生产性能。
text_en: Chlorogenic acid (CGA), as a traditional Chinese medicine, can improve animal immunity and antioxidant capacity, and improve production performance.
outcome: 免疫力、抗氧化能力、生产性能

quote: In this study, crucian carp (Carassius auratus) was fed with complete feed containing 200 mg/kg CGA for 60 days to evaluate the antioxidant, immuno-enhancement, and regulation of intestinal microbial activities of CGA.
statement: 本研究通过给鲫鱼饲喂含200 mg/kg CGA的全价饲料60天，以评估CGA的抗氧化、免疫增强及肠道微生物调节作用。
text_zh: 本研究通过给鲫鱼饲喂含200 mg/kg CGA的全价饲料60天，以评估CGA的抗氧化、免疫增强及肠道微生物调节作用。
text_en: This study evaluated the antioxidant, immunomodulatory, and gut microbiota-regulating effects of CGA by feeding crucian carp a complete diet containing 200 mg/kg CGA for 60 days.

quote: Additionally, the non-specific immune enzyme activities of intestinal and liver tissues were increased,
statement: 此外，肠道和肝脏组织的非特异性免疫酶活性增加。
text_zh: 此外，肠道和肝脏组织的非特异性免疫酶活性增加。
text_en: In addition, the non-specific immune enzyme activity in intestinal and liver tissues increased.

quote: The antioxidant capacity of intestinal, muscle, and liver tissues was improved.
statement: 肠道、肌肉和肝脏组织的抗氧化能力得到改善。
text_zh: 肠道、肌肉和肝脏组织的抗氧化能力得到改善。
text_en: The antioxidant capacity of intestinal, muscle, and liver tissues was improved.

quote: Otherwise, CGA enhanced the relative abundance of intestinal microbes, Fusobacteria and Firmicutes and degraded the relative abundance of Proteobacteria .
statement: 另外，CGA增加了肠道微生物中梭杆菌门和厚壁菌门的相对丰度，并降低了变形菌门的相对丰度。
text_zh: 另外，CGA增加了肠道微生物中梭杆菌门和厚壁菌门的相对丰度，并降低了变形菌门的相对丰度。
text_en: In addition, CGA increased the relative abundance of Fusobacteriota and Firmicutes in the gut microbiota, and decreased the relative abundance of Proteobacteria.

quote: The mechanism of action may be related to the significant increase of the intestinal amylase and lipase activities of Carassius auratus , as the enhancement of the digestive function of the intestine will contribute to the full absorption of nutrients.
statement: 其作用机制可能与鲫鱼肠道淀粉酶和脂肪酶活性的显著增加有关，因为肠道消化功能的增强有助于营养物质的充分吸收。
text_zh: 其作用机制可能与鲫鱼肠道淀粉酶和脂肪酶活性的显著增加有关，因为肠道消化功能的增强有助于营养物质的充分吸收。
text_en: Its mechanism of action may be related to the significant increase in intestinal amylase and lipase activities in crucian carp, because enhanced intestinal digestive function helps with the full absorption of nutrients.

quote: Meanwhile, oral CGA also had a positive effect on the density and height of the intestinal villi of Carassius auratus .
statement: 同时，口服CGA也对鲫鱼肠道绒毛的密度和高度有积极影响。
text_zh: 同时，口服CGA也对鲫鱼肠道绒毛的密度和高度有积极影响。
text_en: At the same time, oral CGA also had a positive effect on the density and height of intestinal villi in crucian carp.

quote: The density and height of villi in the intestine can increase the contact area between the intestine and intestinal contents, thus increasing the deposition of nutrients, which is of great significance for improving the health of animals (Fu et al., 2021).
statement: 肠道绒毛的密度和高度可以增加肠道与肠内容物之间的接触面积，从而增加营养沉积，这对改善动物健康具有重要意义。
text_zh: 肠道绒毛的密度和高度可以增加肠道与肠内容物之间的接触面积，从而增加营养沉积，这对改善动物健康具有重要意义。
text_en: The density and height of intestinal villi can increase the contact area between the intestine and intestinal contents, thereby increasing nutrient deposition, which is of great significance for improving animal health.

quote: In our study, CGA significantly increased the activities of ACP and AKP in the intestinal tissue of Carassius auratus , that corresponded to the results of the increase in the number of goblet cells per unit length, which both improved intestinal immunity to a certain extent.
statement: 在本研究中，CGA显著增加了鲫鱼肠道组织中ACP和AKP的活性，这与单位长度杯状细胞数量增加的结果相对应，两者都在一定程度上改善了肠道免疫力。
text_zh: 在本研究中，CGA显著增加了鲫鱼肠道组织中ACP和AKP的活性，这与单位长度杯状细胞数量增加的结果相对应，两者都在一定程度上改善了肠道免疫力。
text_en: In this study, CGA significantly increased the activity of ACP and AKP in the intestinal tissue of crucian carp, which corresponded to an increase in the number of goblet cells per unit length; both improved intestinal immunity to some extent.

quote: During this period, the temperature of the dechlorinated water was maintained at 25 ± 1 °C, and the oxygen content was maintained above 90% saturation.
statement: 在此期间，除氯水的温度维持在25 ± 1 °C，氧气含量维持在饱和度的90%以上。
text_zh: 在此期间，除氯水的温度维持在25 ± 1 °C，氧气含量维持在饱和度的90%以上。
text_en: During this period, the temperature of the chlorine water was maintained at 25 ± 1 °C, and the oxygen content was maintained at above 90% saturation.

quote: All fish were fed once daily at 8:00 am with a commercial floating diet (Tongwei Company, Chengdu, China).
statement: 所有鱼每天上午8点喂食一次商业浮性饲料。
text_zh: 所有鱼每天上午8点喂食一次商业浮性饲料。
text_en: All fish were fed commercial floating feed once daily at 8 a.m.

quote: The uneaten food and feces were cleaned up using a siphon.
statement: 未食用的食物和粪便通过虹吸清理。
text_zh: 未食用的食物和粪便通过虹吸清理。
text_en: Uneaten food and feces are removed by siphoning.

quote: Otherwise, the relative abundance of the Aeromonadaceae significantly decreased from 62.74 to 10.27% as the CGA was added (Figure 6C).
statement: 随着绿原酸的添加，气单胞菌科的相对丰度从62.74%显著下降至10.27%。
text_zh: 随着绿原酸的添加，气单胞菌科的相对丰度从62.74%显著下降至10.27%。
text_en: With the addition of chlorogenic acid, the relative abundance of Aeromonadaceae significantly decreased from 62.74% to 10.27%.

quote: As shown in Table 4 , the Ace, Chao1, and observed species indices reduced from 148 to 142, 150 to 144, and 146 to 138, respectively, as CGA was added to the feed.
statement: 如表4所示，随着饲料中添加绿原酸，Ace、Chao1和观察到的物种指数分别从148降至142、150降至144以及146降至138。
text_zh: 如表4所示，随着饲料中添加绿原酸，Ace、Chao1和观察到的物种指数分别从148降至142、150降至144以及146降至138。
text_en: As shown in Table 4, with the addition of chlorogenic acid to the feed, the Ace, Chao1, and observed species indices decreased from 148 to 142, 150 to 144, and 146 to 138, respectively.

quote: To avoid foraging behaviour, fish were fed to apparent satiation 2 h before the measurements.
statement: 在测量前2小时将鱼喂至表观饱食状态，以避免摄食行为。
text_zh: 在测量前2小时将鱼喂至表观饱食状态，以避免摄食行为。
text_en: Fish were fed to apparent satiation 2 hours before measurement to avoid feeding behavior.

quote: The test fish were then introduced to the centre of the test tank with a holding device (plastic cylinder with 10 cm of diameter and 15 cm of height) and remained in the device for 3 min.
statement: 测试鱼通过保持装置引入测试水箱中心，并在该装置中停留3分钟。
text_zh: 测试鱼通过保持装置引入测试水箱中心，并在该装置中停留3分钟。
text_en: Test fish were introduced into the center of the test tank via a restraint device and remained in that device for 3 minutes.
intervention_record: 使用保持装置限制活动
outcome: 操作应激/行为记录准备

quote: After that period, the holding device was gently removed, and the position of the test fish was recorded for 15 min at 15 frames/s.
statement: 随后轻轻移除保持装置，并以15帧/秒的速度记录测试鱼的位置15分钟。
text_zh: 随后轻轻移除保持装置，并以15帧/秒的速度记录测试鱼的位置15分钟。
text_en: The holding device was then gently removed, and the position of the test fish was recorded at a rate of 15 frames per second for 15 minutes.

quote: our results showed that feeding supplemented with CGA could increase the expression of genes related to lipid metabolism in the liver, improve the activities of non-specific immune enzymes in intestinal and liver tissues, promote the antioxidant capacity of intestinal, muscle, and liver tissues.
statement: 我们的结果表明，补充CGA的喂养可以增加肝脏中与脂质代谢相关的基因表达，提高肠道和肝组织中非特异性免疫酶的活性，并促进肠道、肌肉和肝组织的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 我们的结果表明，补充CGA的喂养可以增加肝脏中与脂质代谢相关的基因表达，提高肠道和肝组织中非特异性免疫酶的活性，并促进肠道、肌肉和肝组织的抗氧化能力。
text_en: Our results indicate that feeding supplemented with CGA can increase the expression of genes related to lipid metabolism in the liver, enhance the activity of non-specific immune enzymes in intestinal and hepatic tissues, and promote antioxidant capacity in intestinal, muscle, and hepatic tissues.
outcome: 脂质代谢、免疫酶活性及抗氧化能力

quote: At the family level, Fusobacteriaceae and Erysipelotrichaceae were the dominant families in the CGA-added group, while the relative abundance of Aeromonadaceae decreased significantly.
statement: 在科水平上，梭杆菌科和丹毒丝菌科是添加CGA组的优势科，而气单胞菌科的相对丰度显著降低。
text_zh: 在科水平上，梭杆菌科和丹毒丝菌科是添加CGA组的优势科，而气单胞菌科的相对丰度显著降低。
text_en: At the family level, Fusobacteriaceae and Erysipelotrichaceae were the dominant families in the group with CGA added to feed, while the relative abundance of Aeromonadaceae was significantly reduced.

quote: Overall, our study showed that supplementation with CGA in diet had a significant positive impact on Carassius auratus .
statement: 总体而言，本研究表明日粮中添加CGA对鲫鱼有显著的积极影响。
text_zh: 总体而言，本研究表明日粮中添加CGA对鲫鱼有显著的积极影响。
text_en: Overall, this study indicates that dietary supplementation with CGA has a significant positive effect on crucian carp.

quote: It is of great significance to develop and use CGA, a natural and innocuous compound, in green and eco-friendly feed additives with effective preventive effects.
statement: 开发和使用CGA这种天然无害化合物作为具有有效预防作用的绿色生态饲料添加剂具有重要意义。

quote: Our findings provided a reference for exploring the CGA for replacing some chemical drugs and antibiotics to prevent and control fish diseases.

quote: the coexistence of heterospecies did show a negative effect on the numerical ability of qingbo, as the qingbo in heterospecific dyads could not even discriminate in the numerical comparison of 8 vs. 12.

text_en: Heterospecific coexistence had a negative effect on the numerical discrimination ability of *Coreius guichenoti*, manifested as an inability to distinguish between the values 8 and 12.

quote: We found that feeding CGA could reduce the production of lipid peroxides in the Carassius auratus intestinal and muscle, and improve the total antioxidant enzyme SOD, POD, and the antioxidant substances GSH levels of the liver tissue.
statement: 我们发现饲喂CGA可以减少鲫鱼肠道和肌肉中脂质过氧化物的产生，并提高肝组织中总抗氧化酶SOD、POD以及抗氧化物质GSH的水平。
text_zh: 我们发现饲喂CGA可以减少鲫鱼肠道和肌肉中脂质过氧化物的产生，并提高肝组织中总抗氧化酶SOD、POD以及抗氧化物质GSH的水平。
text_en: We found that feeding chlorogenic acid (CGA) can reduce the production of lipid peroxides in the intestine and muscle of crucian carp, and increase the levels of total antioxidant enzymes SOD and POD as well as the antioxidant substance GSH in liver tissue.

quote: Thus, the enhancement of the metabolism index inflected the improvement body’s antioxidant and immune capacity.
statement: 因此，代谢指数的增强反映了机体抗氧化和免疫能力的改善。
text_zh: 因此，代谢指数的增强反映了机体抗氧化和免疫能力的改善。
text_en: Therefore, the enhancement of metabolic indices reflects improved antioxidant and immune capabilities of the organism.

quote: the company of crucian carp showed a negative effect on the numerical ability of qingbo, as qingbo in heterospecific dyads could not even discriminate in the 8 vs. 12 comparisons (the threshold of singletons).

text_en: The presence of crucian carp had a negative effect on the numerical discrimination ability of qingbo, causing qingbo in heterospecific pairs to be unable to distinguish between the quantity comparison of 8 and 12.
limitations: 未进行比2:3更简单的数值比较，因此无法确定单只或成对鲫鱼的阈值；两种鱼偏好不同栖息地，可能导致信息传递和共识难以达成。

text_en: Perubahan patologi anatomi diamati dan dianalisis menggunakan sistem skoring berdasarkan luas area kerusakan pada sisi tubuh ikan dari kepala hingga sirip ekor.

quote: Dasar skoring yang digunakan yaitu : Nilai 0 : jika belum terjadi kerusakan pada kedua sisi ikan komet (belum terjadi perubahan patologi). Nilai 1 : jika terdapat bagian yang luka kurang dari atau sama dengan 25% pada kedua sisi ikan komet. Nilai 2 : jika terdapat bagian yang luka lebih dari atau sama dengan 26-50% pada kedua sisi ikan komet. Nilai 3 : jika terdapat bagian luka lebih dari atau sama dengan 51-75% pada kedua sisi ikan komet. Nilai 4 : jika terdapat bagian yang luka lebih dari atau sama dengan 76% pada kedua sisi ikan komet.
statement: Sistem skoring patologi anatomi berkisar dari 0 (tidak ada kerusakan) hingga 4 (kerusakan lebih dari 76% pada kedua sisi tubuh ikan).
text_en: Sistem skoring patologi anatomi berkisar dari 0 (tidak ada kerusakan) hingga 4 (kerusakan lebih dari 76% pada kedua sisi tubuh ikan).

statement: Penelitian ini menggunakan metode eksperimental untuk mengetahui perubahan histopatologi jaringan kulit ikan komet akibat infestasi A. japonicus.
text_en: Penelitian ini menggunakan metode eksperimental untuk mengetahui perubahan histopatologi jaringan kulit ikan komet akibat infestasi A. japonicus.

jam dengan tujuan untuk menghilangkan

quote:
Media pemeliharaan berupa air tawar. Air
tersebut ditempatkan di dalam akuarium
berukuran (20x10x10) cm3 sebanyak empat
liter/akuarium.

text_en: Media pemeliharaan adalah air tawar yang ditempatkan dalam akuarium berukuran 20x10x10 cm3 dengan volume empat liter per akuarium.

quote:
Kualitas air media pemeli-
haraan dijaga agar kondisinya tetap baik
dengan melakukan penyiponan kotoran sisa
pakan dan metabolisme dalam akuarium
setiap hari.

Penyiponan sekaligus mengganti air
sebanyak 50% dari air sebelumnya.

Pengukuran dan pencatatan kualitas air
dilakukan setiap hari. Pengukuran kualitas
air meliputi pH dengan refraktometer, suhu
dengan termometer, dan kelarutan oksigen
dengan dissolved oxygen meter.
