text_en: Kualitas air diukur dan dicatat setiap hari, mencakup pH, suhu, dan kelarutan oksigen menggunakan alat ukur spesifik.

quote: However, significance differences were observed in other parameters like electrical conductivity (EC), total dissolved solids (TDS) and suspended solids (SS).
statement: 然而，在电导率（EC）、总溶解固体（TDS）和悬浮固体（SS）等其他参数中观察到了显著差异。
text_zh: 然而，在电导率（EC）、总溶解固体（TDS）和悬浮固体（SS）等其他参数中观察到了显著差异。
text_en: However, significant differences were observed in other parameters such as electrical conductivity (EC), total dissolved solids (TDS), and suspended solids (SS).

quote: Site 1 has demonstrated significantly the highest EC (1245.12±5.34 µS/cm), TDS (756.10±1.50mg/L) and SS (24.5±0.15 mg/L).
statement: 站点1显示出最高的电导率、总溶解固体和悬浮固体水平。
text_zh: 站点1显示出最高的电导率、总溶解固体和悬浮固体水平。
text_en: Site 1 showed the highest levels of electrical conductivity, total dissolved solids, and suspended solids.

quote: The concentrations of heavy metals in water samples from Lake Ziway at site 1 (close to floriculture industry) presented significantly the highest amount of all the tested metals including Cd (2.71mg/L), Cu (4.88mg/L), Ni (8.10mg/L), Pb (6.06mg/L) and Zn (12.12mg/L).
statement: 齐瓦伊湖站点1（靠近花卉种植业）水样中的重金属浓度在所有测试金属中均呈现最高水平。
text_zh: 齐瓦伊湖站点1（靠近花卉种植业）水样中的重金属浓度在所有测试金属中均呈现最高水平。
text_en: Heavy metal concentrations in water samples at Site 1 of Lake Zway (near flower cultivation) showed the highest levels among all tested metals.

quote: Determination of physicochemical parameters including PH, electrical conductivity, total soluble solids, and hardness were based on standard method of APHA (2005).
statement: 水质理化参数（包括pH、电导率、总可溶性固体和硬度）的测定基于APHA (2005)的标准方法。
text_zh: 水质理化参数（包括pH、电导率、总可溶性固体和硬度）的测定基于APHA (2005)的标准方法。
text_en: The determination of water quality physicochemical parameters (including pH, electrical conductivity, total dissolved solids and hardness) was based on the standard methods of APHA (2005).

quote: The electrodes were immersed into the sample of water (whose pH is to be determined) and wait up to one minute for steady reading.
statement: 将电极浸入待测水样中，并等待长达一分钟以获得稳定读数。
text_zh: 将电极浸入待测水样中，并等待长达一分钟以获得稳定读数。
text_en: Immerse the electrode in the water sample to be tested and wait for up to one minute to obtain a stable reading.

quote:
Significantly the highest load of metal accumulations in fish muscles were observed at site
1 (near floriculture industry) in Nile tilapia with load of Zn (100.37), Cd (6.05), Ni (4.70), Pb (5.76) and Cu
(47.54)mg/L.
statement: 在尼罗罗非鱼肌肉中，靠近花卉工业的站点1观察到金属积累负荷显著最高，包括Zn、Cd、Ni、Pb和Cu。
text_zh: 在尼罗罗非鱼肌肉中，靠近花卉工业的站点1观察到金属积累负荷显著最高，包括Zn、Cd、Ni、Pb和Cu。
text_en: In Nile tilapia muscle, site 1 near the flower industry showed significantly highest metal accumulation loads, including Zn, Cd, Ni, Pb and Cu.

quote:
The comparison of heavy metal accumulation across lake sites in fish muscle samples
indicated that the highest accumulations were obtained for Cu and Zn; small amounts of Cd, Ni & Pb.
statement: 对湖泊各站点鱼肌肉样本中重金属积累的对比表明，Cu和Zn的积累量最高；Cd、Ni和Pb的量较少。
text_zh: 对湖泊各站点鱼肌肉样本中重金属积累的对比表明，Cu和Zn的积累量最高；Cd、Ni和Pb的量较少。
text_en: Comparison of heavy metal accumulation in fish muscle samples from various lake sites showed that Cu and Zn had the highest accumulation levels; Cd, Ni, and Pb were lower.

quote: High concentrations have several negative effects, such as decreasing the amount of light that can penetrate the water, thereby slowing photosynthetic processes which in turn can lower the production of dissolved oxygen; high absorption of heat from sunlight, thus increasing the temperature which can result to lower oxygen level; low visibility which will affect the fish’ ability to hunt for food; clog fish’ gills; prevent development of egg and larva.
statement: 高浓度的悬浮固体通过减少光照、增加水温、降低能见度等机制，导致溶解氧降低、影响鱼类捕食能力、堵塞鱼鳃以及阻碍卵和幼虫的发育。
text_zh: 高浓度的悬浮固体通过减少光照、增加水温、降低能见度等机制，导致溶解氧降低、影响鱼类捕食能力、堵塞鱼鳃以及阻碍卵和幼虫的发育。
text_en: High concentrations of suspended solids lead to reduced dissolved oxygen, affect fish predation ability, clog fish gills, and hinder the development of eggs and larvae through mechanisms such as reducing light, increasing water temperature, and lowering visibility.
outcome: 呼吸/摄食/发育/水质压力

quote: memasukkan stylet ke dalam epidermis sampai lapisan jaringan dibawahnya. Hal ini berpotensi mengakibatkan kerusakan erosi jaringan epidermis karena penetrasi stylet menembus lapisan epidermis dengan cara menusuk sehingga mengakibatkan pengikisan epitel epidermis.
statement: Penetrasi stylet parasit ke dalam epidermis berpotensi menyebabkan erosi dan pengikisan epitel epidermis.
text_en: Penetrasi stylet parasit ke dalam epidermis berpotensi menyebabkan erosi dan pengikisan epitel epidermis.

quote: Berdasarkan hasil penelitian ini, kerusakan jaringan ballooning degenera- tion ditemukan pada perlakuan infestasi sedang.
statement: Kerusakan jaringan berupa ballooning degeneration ditemukan pada tingkat infestasi sedang.
text_en: Kerusakan jaringan berupa ballooning degeneration ditemukan pada tingkat infestasi sedang.

quote: Hasil pemeriksaan kualitas air selama penelitian berada pada kisaran normal untuk pemeliharaan ikan komet, yaitu suhu 24-250C, pH 7-8, dan DO 5-6 mg/l.
statement: Parameter kualitas air selama penelitian berada dalam kisaran normal untuk pemeliharaan ikan komet.
text_en: Parameter kualitas air selama penelitian berada dalam kisaran normal untuk pemeliharaan ikan komet.

quote: Kondisi pemeliharaan ikan komet yang baik selama penelitian dapat meminimalkan pengaruh lain di luar pengaruh infestasi A. japonicus agar data dapat digunakan sebagai acuan untuk pengembangan ilmu pengetahuan.
statement: Kondisi pemeliharaan yang baik membantu mengisolasi efek infestasi dari faktor lingkungan lainnya.
text_en: Kondisi pemeliharaan yang baik membantu mengisolasi efek infestasi dari faktor lingkungan lainnya.

quote: Hubungan derajat infestasi dan kerusakan patologi anatomi ikan komet menunjukkan korelasi yang positif.
statement: Terdapat korelasi positif antara derajat infestasi dan tingkat kerusakan patologi anatomi pada ikan komet.
text_en: Terdapat korelasi positif antara derajat infestasi dan tingkat kerusakan patologi anatomi pada ikan komet.

quote: Grafik persamaan y = 0,06 + 0,142x menunjukkan bahwa semakin tinggi derajat infestasi A. japonicus, semakin tinggi skor patologi anatomi ikan komet.
statement: Persamaan regresi menunjukkan bahwa peningkatan derajat infestasi A. japonicus diikuti oleh peningkatan skor patologi anatomi ikan komet.
text_en: Persamaan regresi menunjukkan bahwa peningkatan derajat infestasi A. japonicus diikuti oleh peningkatan skor patologi anatomi ikan komet.

quote: Nilai koefisien korelasi (r = 0,98) menunjukkan adanya pengaruh yang kuat antara derajat infestasi A. japonicus terhadap perubahan patologi anatomi.
statement: Koefisien korelasi sebesar 0,98 mengindikasikan pengaruh yang kuat dari derajat infestasi A. japonicus terhadap perubahan patologi anatomi.
text_en: Koefisien korelasi sebesar 0,98 mengindikasikan pengaruh yang kuat dari derajat infestasi A. japonicus terhadap perubahan patologi anatomi.

quote: Hal ini juga dapat dilihat dari nilai rerata derajat infestasi berat (2,5) yang memberikan dampak kerusakan patologi anatomi yang berbeda nyata (p<0,05) dengan perlakuan kontrol (0), derajat infestasi ringan (1) dan derajat infestasi sedang (1,5).
statement: Derajat infestasi berat (2,5) menyebabkan kerusakan patologi anatomi yang secara statistik berbeda nyata dibandingkan kontrol, infestasi ringan, dan infestasi sedang.
text_en: Derajat infestasi berat (2,5) menyebabkan kerusakan patologi anatomi yang secara statistik berbeda nyata dibandingkan kontrol, infestasi ringan, dan infestasi sedang.

quote: Berdasarkan analisis tersebut dapat disimpulkan bahwa semakin tinggi derajat infestasi A. japonicus, semakin tinggi tingkat kerusakan patologi anatomi ikan komet yang ditimbulkan.
statement: Kesimpulan analisis menyatakan bahwa derajat infestasi A. japonicus yang lebih tinggi menghasilkan tingkat kerusakan patologi anatomi yang lebih tinggi pada ikan komet.
text_en: Kesimpulan analisis menyatakan bahwa derajat infestasi A. japonicus yang lebih tinggi menghasilkan tingkat kerusakan patologi anatomi yang lebih tinggi pada ikan komet.

quote: Hal ini terlihat dari adanya pendarahan pada beberapa bagian kulit dan sirip.
statement: Kerusakan patologi anatomi ditandai dengan adanya pendarahan pada bagian kulit dan sirip ikan.
text_en: Kerusakan patologi anatomi ditandai dengan adanya pendarahan pada bagian kulit dan sirip ikan.

quote: Pendarahan pada infestasi berat terlihat lebih jelas dan dominan dibandingkan dengan derajat infestasi sedang dan infestasi ringan.
statement: Gejala pendarahan akibat infestasi berat lebih jelas dan dominan dibandingkan dengan infestasi sedang dan ringan.
text_en: Gejala pendarahan akibat infestasi berat lebih jelas dan dominan dibandingkan dengan infestasi sedang dan ringan.

quote:
It can also be an
indicator of higher concentration of bacteria, nutrients and
pollutants in the water (Tarazona and Munoz, 1995).
statement: 该指标也可反映水中细菌、营养物质和污染物浓度较高。
text_zh: 该指标也可反映水中细菌、营养物质和污染物浓度较高。
text_en: This indicator can also reflect higher concentrations of bacteria, nutrients, and pollutants in the water.

quote:
Significance differences in the heavy metals load were
observed among the three sites that might be due to the distance
among the sample sites or the huge continuous discharge of toxic
wastes from floriculture industries.
statement: 三个站点间重金属负荷存在显著差异，这可能归因于采样点之间的距离或花卉工业持续排放的大量有毒废物。
text_zh: 三个站点间重金属负荷存在显著差异，这可能归因于采样点之间的距离或花卉工业持续排放的大量有毒废物。
text_en: There are significant differences in heavy metal loads among the three sites, which may be attributed to the distance between sampling points or the large amount of toxic waste continuously discharged by the flower industry.

quote:
Even though heavy metal contents in water
and sediments are below the acceptable levels, a hazardous
possibility may generate depending on rapid expansion
(Kebede et al., 2012).
statement: 尽管水和沉积物中的重金属含量低于可接受水平，但根据快速扩张的情况，仍可能产生危险的可能性。
text_zh: 尽管水和沉积物中的重金属含量低于可接受水平，但根据快速扩张的情况，仍可能产生危险的可能性。
text_en: Although the heavy metal content in water and sediment is below acceptable levels, there remains a possibility of hazard given the rapid expansion.

quote: The quality of fresh water for fish should not allow accumulation of pollutants especially heavy metals in fish to such extent that they are potentially harmful (Alabaster and Lloyed, 1982).
statement: 淡水水质标准应防止鱼类体内污染物（特别是重金属）积累到潜在有害的程度。
text_zh: 淡水水质标准应防止鱼类体内污染物（特别是重金属）积累到潜在有害的程度。
text_en: Freshwater water quality standards should prevent the accumulation of pollutants (especially heavy metals) in fish bodies to potentially harmful levels.

quote:
The solubility of heavy metals is
predominately controlled by the water pH (Osmond et al.,
1995), water temperature (Iwashita and Shimamura, 2003;
Papafilippaki et al., 2008) and the redox environment of the
lake water (Osmond et al., 1995; Iwashita and Shimamura,
2003; Papafilippaki et al., 2008).
statement: 重金属的溶解度主要受水体pH值、水温和湖泊水的氧化还原环境控制。
text_zh: 重金属的溶解度主要受水体pH值、水温和湖泊水的氧化还原环境控制。
text_en: The solubility of heavy metals is mainly controlled by the pH, water temperature, and redox environment of lake water.
outcome: 重金属溶解度与潜在暴露风险

quote: Also, multi-filament gill nets with the mesh sizes of 30, 40 and 50 mm and multi-filament trammel nets with 70 and 110 mm mesh sizes were used for C. gibelio sampling.
statement: 使用不同网目的多丝刺网和多丝挂网对银鲫进行采样。
text_zh: 使用不同网目的多丝刺网和多丝挂网对银鲫进行采样。

text_zh: 鱼样立即通过冷藏箱转移至实验室。

statement: 长期暴露于高摄入量的镍可导致体重下降、心脏和肝脏损伤以及皮肤刺激。

text_zh: 目前，中草药越来越多地通过促进免疫功能来预防和治疗水产养殖物种的疾病。

text_en: Ikan kontrol (tanpa infestasi) menunjukkan aktivitas berenang normal dan tampak sehat hingga akhir penelitian.

text_en: Di akhir masa perlakuan, terjadi kerontokan sisik dan perubahan warna kulit menjadi agak pucat.

text_en: At Site 1, near the flower cultivation industry, metal accumulation in Nile tilapia muscle was highest, and all detected metal loads were above World Health Organization recommended levels.

quote: However, the deterioration of the aquaculture environment can cause oxidative stress, inflammatory reactions, and tissue damage in fish, then affecting the safety of aquatic products (2).

text_en: Deterioration of the farming environment leads to oxidative stress, inflammatory responses, and tissue damage in fish, thereby affecting the safety of aquatic products.
outcome: 环境恶化导致的健康损害

quote: Similarly, it has been reported that LPS induces oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in zebrafish (8), carp (9), and yellow catfish (10).
statement: 据报道，LPS会在斑马鱼、鲤鱼和黄颡鱼中诱导氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 据报道，LPS会在斑马鱼、鲤鱼和黄颡鱼中诱导氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。
text_en: It is reported that LPS induces oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis in zebrafish, carp, and yellow catfish.
outcome: 氧化应激、炎症、细胞凋亡

quote: The fish were lightly anaesthetized with MS-222 at a concentration of 60 mg/L and then weighed.
statement: 鱼使用浓度为60 mg/L的MS-222进行轻度麻醉，然后称重。
text_zh: 鱼使用浓度为60 mg/L的MS-222进行轻度麻醉，然后称重。
text_en: Fish were lightly anesthetized using MS-222 at a concentration of 60 mg/L, then weighed.

quote: Then, they were administered an intraperitoneal injection of 5 μL/g body mass LPS (5.0 mg/mL, Sigma, St. Louis, Mo., USA) and placed into triplicate tanks per treatment (26).
statement: 随后对鱼进行腹腔注射脂多糖（LPS），剂量为每克体重5微升，并将它们放入每个处理组的三个重复水箱中。
text_zh: 随后对鱼进行腹腔注射脂多糖（LPS），剂量为每克体重5微升，并将它们放入每个处理组的三个重复水箱中。
text_en: Fish were subsequently injected intraperitoneally with lipopolysaccharide (LPS) at a dose of 5 microliters per gram of body weight and placed into three replicate tanks per treatment group.

quote: Two fish per tank were anaesthetized and sampled at 0, 6, and 12 h after injection (n = 6 at each sampling time).
statement: 每个水箱中的两条鱼在注射后0、6和12小时被麻醉并采样。
text_zh: 每个水箱中的两条鱼在注射后0、6和12小时被麻醉并采样。
text_en: Two fish in each tank were anesthetized and sampled at 0, 6, and 12 hours after injection.

quote: Blood was drawn from a vein using syringes rinsed with heparin sodium (0.2%) at 0, 6, and 12 h after LPS injection.
statement: 在LPS注射后0、6和12小时，使用经肝素钠（0.2%）冲洗过的注射器从静脉采血。
text_zh: 在LPS注射后0、6和12小时，使用经肝素钠（0.2%）冲洗过的注射器从静脉采血。
text_en: Blood was collected from the vein at 0, 6, and 12 hours after LPS injection using syringes rinsed with heparin sodium (0.2%).

quote: After the feeding experiment, gibel carp were fasted for 24 h.
statement: 在饲养实验结束后，银鲫被禁食24小时。
text_zh: 在饲养实验结束后，银鲫被禁食24小时。
text_en: After the feeding experiment ended, silver crucian carp were fasted for 24 hours.

quote: No significant difference was observed in C3.
statement: 在C3方面未观察到显著差异。
text_zh: 在C3方面未观察到显著差异。
text_en: No significant difference was observed in C3.

quote: Higher expression levels of tnf-α and il-10 but lower expression levels of il-12 were found in fish fed the RES diet.
statement: 与对照组相比，喂食含RES饲料的鱼表现出更高的tnf-α和il-10表达水平，以及更低的il-12表达水平。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，喂食含RES饲料的鱼表现出更高的tnf-α和il-10表达水平，以及更低的il-12表达水平。
text_en: Compared to the control group, fish fed a diet containing RES showed higher expression levels of TNF-α and IL-10, and lower expression levels of IL-12.

quote: Our study elucidates effects of RES on oxidative stress and inflammation in LPS-induced gibel carp for the first time, and provides an effective strategy to mitigate LPS-induced liver damage in fish.
statement: 本研究首次阐明了白藜芦醇（RES）对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的鲫鱼氧化应激和炎症的影响，并为减轻鱼类LPS诱导的肝损伤提供了一种有效策略。
text_zh: 本研究首次阐明了白藜芦醇（RES）对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的鲫鱼氧化应激和炎症的影响，并为减轻鱼类LPS诱导的肝损伤提供了一种有效策略。
text_en: This study is the first to elucidate the effects of resveratrol (RES) on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced oxidative stress and inflammation in crucian carp, and provides an effective strategy for alleviating LPS-induced liver injury in fish.
outcome: 氧化应激、炎症及肝脏健康

quote: Before the formal experiment, fish were temporarily raised in a circular aquaculture system for acclimation.
statement: 在正式实验前，鱼在圆形水产养殖系统中暂养以适应环境。
text_zh: 在正式实验前，鱼在圆形水产养殖系统中暂养以适应环境。
text_en: Before the formal experiment, fish were acclimated in circular aquaculture systems to adapt to the environment.

quote: The water temperature was maintained at 29–31°C; total ammonia nitrogen was 7.0 mg/L, and the photoperiod was 12L:12D.
statement: 水温维持在29–31°C；总氨氮为7.0 mg/L；光周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_zh: 水温维持在29–31°C；总氨氮为7.0 mg/L；光周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_en: Water temperature was maintained at 29–31°C; total ammonia nitrogen was 7.0 mg/L; photoperiod was 12 hours light:12 hours dark.

quote: The AST, ALT, and LDH levels were significantly increased at both 6 h and 12 h after LPS injection.
statement: 注射LPS后6小时和12小时，血浆中的AST、ALT和LDH水平显著升高。
text_zh: 注射LPS后6小时和12小时，血浆中的AST、ALT和LDH水平显著升高。

quote: It is worth noting that RES significantly reduced the levels of AST, ALT, and LDH in the plasma, except for the AST level at 6 h after injection.
statement: 白藜芦醇（RES）显著降低了血浆中AST、ALT和LDH的水平，除了注射后6小时的AST水平。
text_zh: 白藜芦醇（RES）显著降低了血浆中AST、ALT和LDH的水平，除了注射后6小时的AST水平。
text_en: Resveratrol (RES) significantly reduced plasma levels of AST, ALT and LDH, except for the AST level at 6 hours post-injection.

quote: the liver tissue structure of gibel carp in the CON group and RES group was basically normal.
statement: 对照组和白藜芦醇组鲫鱼肝组织结构基本正常。
text_zh: 对照组和白藜芦醇组鲫鱼肝组织结构基本正常。
text_en: The liver tissue structure of crucian carp in the control group and the resveratrol group was basically normal.

quote: However, at 6 h and 12 h after LPS injection, the hepatocytes of the fish in the CON group showed abnormalities, with mild swelling of hepatocytes in the field of vision, vacuolation of cytoplasm, necrosis
statement: 然而，在注射LPS后6小时和12小时，对照组的鱼肝细胞出现异常，表现为视野中肝细胞轻度肿胀、胞质空泡化和坏死。
text_zh: 然而，在注射LPS后6小时和12小时，对照组的鱼肝细胞出现异常，表现为视野中肝细胞轻度肿胀、胞质空泡化和坏死。
text_en: However, at 6 and 12 hours after LPS injection, fish liver cells in the control group showed abnormalities, manifested as mild swelling of hepatocytes, cytoplasmic vacuolization, and necrosis within the field of view.

quote: Compared to the CON group, the liver injury of fish in the RES group was alleviated, being characterized by a complete hepatocyte structure, uniform size of hepatic sinuses, and no inflammatory cell infiltration.
statement: 与对照组相比，白鲫饲料中添加白藜芦醇（RES）减轻了肝脏损伤，表现为肝细胞结构完整、肝血窦大小均匀且无炎性细胞浸润。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，白鲫饲料中添加白藜芦醇（RES）减轻了肝脏损伤，表现为肝细胞结构完整、肝血窦大小均匀且无炎性细胞浸润。
text_en: Compared with the control group, dietary supplementation of resveratrol (RES) in white crucian carp feed alleviated liver damage, manifested as intact hepatocyte structure, uniform hepatic sinusoid size, and no inflammatory cell infiltration.
outcome: 肝脏组织病理学/炎症反应

quote: Nevertheless, RES significantly reduced the rate of apoptosis in hepatocytes after LPS stimulation.
statement: 然而，在脂多糖（LPS）刺激后，白藜芦醇（RES）显著降低了肝细胞的凋亡率。
text_zh: 然而，在脂多糖（LPS）刺激后，白藜芦醇（RES）显著降低了肝细胞的凋亡率。
text_en: However, after lipopolysaccharide (LPS) stimulation, resveratrol (RES) significantly reduced the apoptosis rate of hepatocytes.

quote: However, compared to the CON group, there was a significant increase in the RES group at 6 h after LPS injection.
statement: 然而，与对照组相比，注射脂多糖（LPS）6小时后，白藜芦醇（RES）组的总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）显著增加。
text_zh: 然而，与对照组相比，注射脂多糖（LPS）6小时后，白藜芦醇（RES）组的总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）显著增加。
text_en: However, compared with the control group, total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) in the resveratrol (RES) group increased significantly 6 hours after lipopolysaccharide (LPS) injection.

quote: RES can decrease lipid oxidative damage in southern flounder (Paralichthys lethostigma) (21).
statement: 白藜芦醇可以降低南方比目鱼的脂质氧化损伤。
text_zh: 白藜芦醇可以降低南方比目鱼的脂质氧化损伤。
text_en: Resveratrol can reduce lipid oxidation damage in southern flounder.

quote: In turbot (Scophthalmus maximus), RES alleviates oxidative stress and inflammatory reactions induced by soybean meal (22).
statement: 在大菱鲆中，白藜芦醇缓解了由豆粕诱导的氧化应激和炎症反应。
text_zh: 在大菱鲆中，白藜芦醇缓解了由豆粕诱导的氧化应激和炎症反应。
text_en: In turbot, resveratrol alleviated soybean meal-induced oxidative stress and inflammatory responses.

quote: Similarly, RES defenses liver damage and metabolic imbalances in common carp (Cyprinus carpio) (23).
statement: 类似地，白藜芦醇防御了鲤鱼的肝脏损伤和代谢失衡。
text_zh: 类似地，白藜芦醇防御了鲤鱼的肝脏损伤和代谢失衡。
text_en: Similarly, resveratrol protected against liver damage and metabolic imbalance in carp.

quote: Thus, RES can reduce oxidative damage and enhance immunity in fish.
statement: 因此，白藜芦醇可以减少鱼类氧化损伤并增强免疫力。
text_zh: 因此，白藜芦醇可以减少鱼类氧化损伤并增强免疫力。
text_en: Therefore, resveratrol can reduce oxidative damage in fish and enhance immunity.

quote: In the previous study, we found that RES could attenuate oxidative stress, inflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction in gibel carp under acute ammonia exposure (25).
statement: 在之前的研究中，我们发现白藜芦醇可以减轻急性氨暴露下异育银鲫的氧化应激、炎症和线粒体功能障碍。
text_zh: 在之前的研究中，我们发现白藜芦醇可以减轻急性氨暴露下异育银鲫的氧化应激、炎症和线粒体功能障碍。
text_en: In previous studies, we found that resveratrol can alleviate oxidative stress, inflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction in gibel carp under acute ammonia exposure.
outcome: 氧化应激、炎症与线粒体功能

quote: Thus, we hypothesized that RES could attenuate LPS-induced liver injury in gibel carp by alleviating oxidative stress and the inflammatory reaction and by regulating mitophagy and mitochondrial biogenesis.
statement: 因此，我们假设白藜芦醇可以通过缓解氧化应激和炎症反应以及调节线粒体自噬和线粒体生物发生来减轻LPS诱导的异育银鲫肝损伤。
text_zh: 因此，我们假设白藜芦醇可以通过缓解氧化应激和炎症反应以及调节线粒体自噬和线粒体生物发生来减轻LPS诱导的异育银鲫肝损伤。
text_en: Therefore, we hypothesize that resveratrol can alleviate LPS-induced liver injury in gibel carp by mitigating oxidative stress and inflammatory responses, as well as regulating mitophagy and mitochondrial biogenesis.

quote: The MDA and LPO contents in the liver tissue of gibel carp of the CON and RES groups were increased significantly at 6 h and 12 h after LPS injection (Figure 4), and the difference was statistically significant between the CON and RES groups.
statement: 在LPS注射后6小时和12小时，对照组（CON）和补充白藜芦醇组（RES）的银鲫肝脏组织中MDA和LPO含量均显著增加，且两组间差异具有统计学意义。
text_zh: 在LPS注射后6小时和12小时，对照组（CON）和补充白藜芦醇组（RES）的银鲫肝脏组织中MDA和LPO含量均显著增加，且两组间差异具有统计学意义。
text_en: At 6 and 12 hours after LPS injection, MDA and LPO contents in the liver tissue of crucian carp increased significantly in both the control group (CON) and the resveratrol-supplemented group (RES), and the difference between the two groups was statistically significant.

quote: At 6 h and 12 h, both MDA and LPO contents in the RES group were dramatically decreased.
statement: 在6小时和12小时时，RES组的MDA和LPO含量均显著降低。
text_zh: 在6小时和12小时时，RES组的MDA和LPO含量均显著降低。
text_en: At 6 hours and 12 hours, the MDA and LPO contents in the RES group were significantly reduced.

quote: Similar changes were also found in ROS.
statement: ROS也发现了类似的变化。
text_zh: ROS也发现了类似的变化。
text_en: Similar changes were also found in ROS.

quote: Compared with the CON group, RES significantly upregulated the expression levels of nrf2 , nqo-1 , and ho-1 at 6 and 12 h after LPS injection and that of gpx and sod at 6 h after LPS injection.
statement: 与CON组相比，RES在LPS注射后6和12小时显著上调了nrf2、nqo-1和ho-1的表达水平，并在LPS注射后6小时显著上调了gpx和sod的表达水平。
text_zh: 与CON组相比，RES在LPS注射后6和12小时显著上调了nrf2、nqo-1和ho-1的表达水平，并在LPS注射后6小时显著上调了gpx和sod的表达水平。
text_en: Compared to the CON group, RES significantly upregulated the expression levels of nrf2, nqo-1, and ho-1 at 6 and 12 hours after LPS injection, and significantly upregulated the expression levels of gpx and sod at 6 hours after LPS injection.

quote: Thus, the results suggested that liver injury was induced by LPS injection in the gibel carp and that the damage was time-dependent.
statement: LPS注射诱导了银鲫的肝损伤，且这种损伤具有时间依赖性。
text_zh: LPS注射诱导了银鲫的肝损伤，且这种损伤具有时间依赖性。
text_en: LPS injection induced liver injury in gibel carp, and this injury was time-dependent.

quote: In this study, RES significantly reduced plasma AST, ALT, and LDH levels and alleviated liver injury in gibel carp after LPS injection.
statement: 在白鲢注射LPS后，白藜芦醇（RES）显著降低了血浆AST、ALT和LDH水平并减轻了肝损伤。
text_zh: 在白鲢注射LPS后，白藜芦醇（RES）显著降低了血浆AST、ALT和LDH水平并减轻了肝损伤。
text_en: After LPS injection in silver carp, resveratrol (RES) significantly reduced plasma AST, ALT and LDH levels and alleviated liver damage.

quote: After 6 h and 12 h of LPS treatment, liver HE staining showed mild swelling and even necrosis of the hepatocytes of the fish liver, accompanied by loss or fragmentation of nuclei, with significantly increased apoptosis.
statement: 在LPS处理6小时和12小时后，肝脏HE染色显示鱼肝细胞轻度肿胀甚至坏死，伴有核丢失或碎裂，凋亡显著增加。
text_zh: 在LPS处理6小时和12小时后，肝脏HE染色显示鱼肝细胞轻度肿胀甚至坏死，伴有核丢失或碎裂，凋亡显著增加。
text_en: After LPS treatment for 6 and 12 hours, liver HE staining showed mild swelling or even necrosis of fish hepatocytes, accompanied by nuclear loss or fragmentation, with significantly increased apoptosis.

quote: However, the liver tissues of gibel carp were basically restored to normal with intact and well-defined hepatocytes, and the number of apoptotic hepatocytes under TUNEL staining was significantly reduced in the RES group after LPS administration.
statement: 然而，在给予LPS后的RES组中，银鲫的肝脏组织基本恢复正常，肝细胞完整且界限分明，TUNEL染色下的凋亡肝细胞数量显著减少。
text_zh: 然而，在给予LPS后的RES组中，银鲫的肝脏组织基本恢复正常，肝细胞完整且界限分明，TUNEL染色下的凋亡肝细胞数量显著减少。
text_en: However, in the RES group after LPS administration, the liver tissue of silver crucian carp had basically returned to normal, with intact and clearly demarcated hepatocytes, and the number of apoptotic hepatocytes under TUNEL staining was significantly reduced.
outcome: 肝脏组织恢复/细胞凋亡

quote: The results showed that LPS induced significant increases in the plasma levels of AST, ALT, and LDH in gibel carp at 6 h post-injection, while by 12 h, the levels of AST and ALT were decreased compared to those at 6 h.
statement: 结果显示，在注射后6小时，脂多糖导致鲫鱼血浆中AST、ALT和LDH水平显著升高，而在12小时时，AST和ALT的水平较6小时时有所下降。
text_zh: 结果显示，在注射后6小时，脂多糖导致鲫鱼血浆中AST、ALT和LDH水平显著升高，而在12小时时，AST和ALT的水平较6小时时有所下降。
text_en: The results showed that at 6 hours after injection, lipopolysaccharide caused a significant increase in plasma AST, ALT and LDH levels in crucian carp, while at 12 hours, the levels of AST and ALT decreased compared to those at 6 hours.

quote: However, RES reversed the expression of these genes, especially at 6 h after LPS injection.
statement: 白藜芦醇（RES）逆转了LPS注射后炎症相关基因的表达，特别是在注射后6小时。
text_zh: 白藜芦醇（RES）逆转了LPS注射后炎症相关基因的表达，特别是在注射后6小时。
text_en: Resveratrol (RES) reversed the expression of inflammation-related genes after LPS injection, particularly at 6 hours post-injection.

quote: Similarly, RES exerted its antioxidant properties by regulating the Nrf2 and TLR2-Myd88-NF-κB signaling pathways that significantly attenuated the liver immunotoxicity in H 2 O 2 -treated tilapia (32).
statement: 白藜芦醇通过调节Nrf2和TLR2-Myd88-NF-κB信号通路发挥抗氧化作用，显著减轻了H2O2处理的罗非鱼的肝脏免疫毒性。
text_zh: 白藜芦醇通过调节Nrf2和TLR2-Myd88-NF-κB信号通路发挥抗氧化作用，显著减轻了H2O2处理的罗非鱼的肝脏免疫毒性。
text_en: Resveratrol (RES) exerted antioxidant effects by regulating the Nrf2 and TLR2-Myd88-NF-κB signaling pathways, significantly reducing hepatic immunotoxicity in H2O2-treated tilapia.
outcome: 肝脏免疫毒性与氧化应激

quote: Taken together, the results suggest that RES may alleviate LPS-induced inflammation in gibel carp by activating Nrf2 and concurrently inhibiting the NF-κB pathway.
statement: 综合结果表明，白藜芦醇可能通过激活Nrf2并抑制NF-κB通路来缓解鲤鲫的LPS诱导的炎症。
text_zh: 综合结果表明，白藜芦醇可能通过激活Nrf2并抑制NF-κB通路来缓解鲤鲫的LPS诱导的炎症。
text_en: The combined results indicate that resveratrol may alleviate LPS-induced inflammation in carp and crucian carp by activating Nrf2 and inhibiting the NF-κB pathway.

quote: In this study, protein expression and antigen levels of SIRT1 and PGC-1α were significantly downregulated at 6 h and 12 h after LPS injection, demonstrating that LPS significantly interfered with the biological process of mitochondrial genesis in gibel carp.
statement: 在LPS注射后6小时和12小时，SIRT1和PGC-1α的蛋白表达和抗原水平显著下调，证明LPS严重干扰了鲤鲫的线粒体生成过程。
text_zh: 在LPS注射后6小时和12小时，SIRT1和PGC-1α的蛋白表达和抗原水平显著下调，证明LPS严重干扰了鲤鲫的线粒体生成过程。
text_en: At 6 and 12 hours after LPS injection, the protein expression and antigen levels of SIRT1 and PGC-1α were significantly downregulated, demonstrating that LPS severely interfered with the mitochondrial biogenesis process in carp crucian.

quote: Before dissection, fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich).
statement: 在解剖前，鱼被用100 mg/L的MS-222深度麻醉。
text_zh: 在解剖前，鱼被用100 mg/L的MS-222深度麻醉。
text_en: Before dissection, the fish were deeply anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222.
outcome: 屠宰/处理前的应激管理

quote: Thus, RES may protect against LPS-induced oxidative stress in gibel carp by upregulating the Nrf2 pathway, and its antioxidant effect was more pronounced at 6 h after LPS injection.
statement: 因此，白藜芦醇可能通过上调Nrf2通路来保护鲫鱼免受LPS诱导的氧化应激，且其抗氧化作用在LPS注射后6小时更为明显。
text_zh: 因此，白藜芦醇可能通过上调Nrf2通路来保护鲫鱼免受LPS诱导的氧化应激，且其抗氧化作用在LPS注射后6小时更为明显。
text_en: Therefore, resveratrol may protect crucian carp from LPS-induced oxidative stress by upregulating the Nrf2 pathway, and its antioxidant effect is more pronounced at 6 hours after LPS injection.

quote: Compared with the CON group, RES significantly increased plasma C4 levels at 6 h.
statement: 与对照组相比，白藜芦醇在6小时时显著增加了血浆C4水平。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，白藜芦醇在6小时时显著增加了血浆C4水平。
text_en: Compared with the control group, resveratrol significantly increased plasma C4 levels at 6 hours.

quote: Significant upregulation of nfkb and its downstream inflammatory factors thf-α , il-6 , and il-1β , but significant downregulation of anti-inflammatory factors tgf-β , il-4 , and il-10 at 6 h and 12 h after LPS injection suggested that severe inflammation was induced.
statement: LPS注射后6小时和12小时，nfkb及其下游炎症因子tnf-α、il-6和il-1β显著上调，而抗炎因子tgf-β、il-4和il-10显著下调，表明诱发了严重的炎症。
text_zh: LPS注射后6小时和12小时，nfkb及其下游炎症因子tnf-α、il-6和il-1β显著上调，而抗炎因子tgf-β、il-4和il-10显著下调，表明诱发了严重的炎症。
text_en: At 6 and 12 hours after LPS injection, nfkb and its downstream inflammatory factors tnf-α, il-6 and il-1β were significantly upregulated, while anti-inflammatory factors tgf-β, il-4 and il-10 were significantly downregulated, indicating that severe inflammation was induced.

quote: Therefore, RES could alleviate the liver injury and significantly reduce the apoptosis of hepatocytes in gibel carp after LPS injection.
statement: 因此，RES可以缓解LPS注射后银鲫的肝脏损伤并显著减少肝细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 因此，RES可以缓解LPS注射后银鲫的肝脏损伤并显著减少肝细胞凋亡。
text_en: Therefore, RES can alleviate liver injury in gibel carp after LPS injection and significantly reduce hepatocyte apoptosis.

quote: In this study, the MDA, LPO, and ROS levels in the liver of gibel carp were increased significantly at 6 h and 12 h after LPS injection and were decreased significantly after RES treatment, suggesting that RES can effectively alleviate LPS-induced oxidative stress.
statement: 本研究中，LPS注射后6小时和12小时银鲫肝脏中的MDA、LPO和ROS水平显著升高，经RES处理后显著降低，表明RES能有效缓解LPS诱导的氧化应激。
text_zh: 本研究中，LPS注射后6小时和12小时银鲫肝脏中的MDA、LPO和ROS水平显著升高，经RES处理后显著降低，表明RES能有效缓解LPS诱导的氧化应激。
text_en: In this study, MDA, LPO and ROS levels in the liver of gibel carp were significantly increased at 6 hours and 12 hours after LPS injection, and were significantly decreased after RES treatment, indicating that RES can effectively alleviate LPS-induced oxidative stress.

quote: Consistent with this study, RES alleviated muscle oxidative damage in southern flounder (21).
statement: 与本项研究一致，RES减轻了南方比目鱼的肌肉氧化损伤。
text_zh: 与本项研究一致，RES减轻了南方比目鱼的肌肉氧化损伤。
text_en: Consistent with this study, RES reduced muscle oxidative damage in southern flounder.

quote: Temporally, the MDA and LPO levels in the liver were significantly lower at 12 h than at 6 h after LPS injection, indicating a reduction in lipid peroxidation.
statement: 从时间上看，LPS注射后12小时的肝脏MDA和LPO水平显著低于6小时，表明脂质过氧化程度降低。
text_zh: 从时间上看，LPS注射后12小时的肝脏MDA和LPO水平显著低于6小时，表明脂质过氧化程度降低。
text_en: In terms of time, liver MDA and LPO levels at 12 hours after LPS injection were significantly lower than those at 6 hours, indicating a reduction in lipid peroxidation.

quote: In our study, liver SOD activity was significantly increased at 6 and 12 h after LPS injection, but T-AOC levels were remarkably reduced at 6 h.
statement: 本研究中，LPS注射后6和12小时肝脏SOD活性显著增加，但6小时T-AOC水平显著降低。
text_zh: 本研究中，LPS注射后6和12小时肝脏SOD活性显著增加，但6小时T-AOC水平显著降低。
text_en: In this study, liver SOD activity significantly increased at 6 and 12 hours after LPS injection, but T-AOC levels significantly decreased at 6 hours.

quote: However, a complete ban on antibiotics may have adverse effects on animal health and farmer profits, and thus various countries are actively seeking animal growth promoters serving as effective alternatives to antibiotics.
statement: 完全禁止抗生素可能对动物健康和农民利润产生不利影响，因此各国正在积极寻求作为抗生素有效替代品的动物生长促进剂。
text_zh: 完全禁止抗生素可能对动物健康和农民利润产生不利影响，因此各国正在积极寻求作为抗生素有效替代品的动物生长促进剂。
text_en: A complete ban on antibiotics may have adverse effects on animal health and farmer profits, so countries are actively seeking animal growth promoters as effective alternatives to antibiotics.
counterevidence: 完全禁止抗生素可能产生不利影响

quote: However, RES significantly increased SOD activity and T-AOC levels at 6 h compared to that in the CON group.
statement: 然而，与对照组相比，RES在6小时时显著增加了SOD活性和T-AOC水平。
text_zh: 然而，与对照组相比，RES在6小时时显著增加了SOD活性和T-AOC水平。
text_en: However, compared with the control group, RES significantly increased SOD activity and T-AOC levels at 6 hours.

quote: Thus, our data indicated that LPS impaired the antioxidant system of gibel carp but reduced lipid peroxidation by enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity.
statement: 因此，我们的数据表明LPS损害了鲫鱼的抗氧化系统，但通过增强抗氧化酶活性减少了脂质过氧化。
text_zh: 因此，我们的数据表明LPS损害了鲫鱼的抗氧化系统，但通过增强抗氧化酶活性减少了脂质过氧化。
text_en: Therefore, our data indicate that LPS impaired the antioxidant system of crucian carp but reduced lipid peroxidation by enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity.

quote: Furthermore, RES could mitigate extra ROS by enhancing antioxidant capacity.
statement: 此外，RES可以通过增强抗氧化能力来减轻额外的ROS。
text_zh: 此外，RES可以通过增强抗氧化能力来减轻额外的ROS。
text_en: In addition, RES can reduce additional ROS by enhancing antioxidant capacity.

quote: In this study, the mRNA expression of nrf2 and downstream nqo-1 , ho-1 , and sod in gibel carp was significantly downregulated at 6 h and 12 h after LPS injection, which may be the result of Nrf2 inactivation.
statement: 在本研究中，鲫鱼nrf2及其下游基因nqo-1、ho-1和sod的mRNA表达在LPS注射后6和12小时显著下调，这可能是Nrf2失活的结果。
text_zh: 在本研究中，鲫鱼nrf2及其下游基因nqo-1、ho-1和sod的mRNA表达在LPS注射后6和12小时显著下调，这可能是Nrf2失活的结果。
text_en: In this study, the mRNA expression of nrf2 and its downstream genes nqo-1, ho-1, and sod in crucian carp was significantly downregulated at 6 and 12 hours after LPS injection, which may be a result of Nrf2 inactivation.

quote: Our results showed that RES treatment remarkably enhanced the gene expression of nrf2 , nqo-1 , ho-1 , gpx , and sod compared with the CON group at 6 h after LPS injection.
statement: 我们的结果显示，与对照组相比，在LPS注射后6小时，RES处理显著增强了nrf2、nqo-1、ho-1、gpx和sod的基因表达。
text_zh: 我们的结果显示，与对照组相比，在LPS注射后6小时，RES处理显著增强了nrf2、nqo-1、ho-1、gpx和sod的基因表达。
text_en: Our results showed that, compared with the control group, RES treatment significantly enhanced the gene expression of nrf2, nqo-1, ho-1, gpx and sod at 6 hours after LPS injection.

quote: The results demonstrated that a RES diet further reduced the stress in gibel carp by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and inhibiting the NF-κB pathway.
statement: 结果表明，白藜芦醇（RES）饲料通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路并抑制NF-κB通路，进一步减轻了鲫鱼的应激。
text_zh: 结果表明，白藜芦醇（RES）饲料通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路并抑制NF-κB通路，进一步减轻了鲫鱼的应激。
text_en: The results showed that resveratrol (RES) feed further alleviated stress in crucian carp by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and inhibiting the NF-κB pathway.

quote: RES alleviated the oxidative stress and inflammation by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and inhibiting the NF-κB pathway induced by LPS.
statement: 白藜芦醇（RES）通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路和抑制由LPS诱导的NF-κB通路，缓解了氧化应激和炎症。
text_zh: 白藜芦醇（RES）通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路和抑制由LPS诱导的NF-κB通路，缓解了氧化应激和炎症。
text_en: Resveratrol (RES) alleviated oxidative stress and inflammation by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway and inhibiting the LPS-induced NF-κB pathway.

quote: Furthermore, RES enhanced mitochondrial autophagy and mitochondrial biogenesis to mitigate ROS accumulation by activating the SIRT1-PGC-1α and PINK/Parkin signaling pathways.
statement: 此外，白藜芦醇（RES）通过激活SIRT1-PGC-1α和PINK/Parkin信号通路，增强了线粒体自噬和线粒体生物合成，从而减轻ROS积累。
text_zh: 此外，白藜芦醇（RES）通过激活SIRT1-PGC-1α和PINK/Parkin信号通路，增强了线粒体自噬和线粒体生物合成，从而减轻ROS积累。
text_en: In addition, resveratrol (RES) reduced ROS accumulation by enhancing mitophagy and mitochondrial biogenesis through the activation of the SIRT1-PGC-1α and PINK/Parkin signaling pathways.

quote: Our results could provide a strategy for enhancing fish immunity in aquaculture.
statement: 研究结果可能为水产养殖中增强鱼类免疫力提供一种策略。
text_zh: 研究结果可能为水产养殖中增强鱼类免疫力提供一种策略。
text_en: The results may provide a strategy for enhancing fish immunity in aquaculture.

quote: Compared to the CON group, the mRNA levels of nfκb , tnf-α , il-6 , il-1β , il-2 , and il-12 were dramatically downregulated, while that of tgf-β , il-4 , and il-10 was upregulated in the RES group.
statement: 与对照组相比，RES组中NF-κB、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IL-2和IL-12的mRNA水平显著下调，而TGF-β、IL-4和IL-10的mRNA水平上调。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，RES组中NF-κB、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IL-2和IL-12的mRNA水平显著下调，而TGF-β、IL-4和IL-10的mRNA水平上调。
text_en: Compared with the control group, mRNA levels of NF-κB, TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, IL-2 and IL-12 were significantly downregulated in the RES group, while mRNA levels of TGF-β, IL-4 and IL-10 were upregulated.

quote: Thus, combined with the upregulation of Nrf2 by RES, RES may induce the antioxidant system and mitochondrial biogenesis by activating the SIRT1-PGC-1α and Nrf2-Keap1 pathways to alleviate mitochondrial dysfunction after LPS injection in gibel carp.
statement: 因此，结合白藜芦醇对Nrf2的上调作用，白藜芦醇可能通过激活SIRT1-PGC-1α和Nrf2-Keap1通路来诱导抗氧化系统和线粒体生物发生，以缓解鲫鱼注射LPS后的线粒体功能障碍。
text_zh: 因此，结合白藜芦醇对Nrf2的上调作用，白藜芦醇可能通过激活SIRT1-PGC-1α和Nrf2-Keap1通路来诱导抗氧化系统和线粒体生物发生，以缓解鲫鱼注射LPS后的线粒体功能障碍。
text_en: Therefore, combined with the upregulation of Nrf2 by resveratrol, resveratrol may induce antioxidant systems and mitochondrial biogenesis by activating the SIRT1-PGC-1α and Nrf2-Keap1 pathways to alleviate mitochondrial dysfunction in crucian carp after LPS injection.

quote: Compared with some pathogens, B. velezensis has stronger nutritional and environmental competitiveness in the host intestine, hence strengthening its inhibitory effect on pathogenic bacteria.
statement: 与某些病原体相比，贝莱斯芽孢杆菌在宿主肠道中具有更强的营养和环境竞争力，从而增强其对致病菌的抑制作用。
text_zh: 与某些病原体相比，贝莱斯芽孢杆菌在宿主肠道中具有更强的营养和环境竞争力，从而增强其对致病菌的抑制作用。
text_en: Compared to certain pathogens, Bacillus velezensis has stronger nutritional and environmental competitiveness in the host gut, thereby enhancing its inhibitory effect on pathogenic bacteria.
